    "statement": "theorem loopHostTM_decides (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (Inv : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 Prop) (stepF : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (acceptF : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 Bool) (s0 : List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (R T : \u2115 \u2192 \u2115) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T) (hInv0 : \u2200 x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x)) (hInvStep : \u2200 (x s : List Bool), Inv x s \u2192 Inv x (stepF x s)) (hstart : \u2200 x : List Bool, \u2203 t \u2264 T x.length, (\u2200 t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state \u2260 some anchor) \u2227 body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x))) (hround : \u2200 (x s : List Bool), Inv x s \u2192 \u2203 t, 0 < t \u2227 t \u2264 T x.length \u2227 (\u2200 t', 0 < t' \u2192 t' < t \u2192 (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state \u2260 some anchor) \u2227 if acceptF x s then (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none \u2227 (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = [true] else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) : (loopHostTM body F anchor false).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [(List.range (R x.length + 1)).any fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))]) (fun n => 10 * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2))"
  },
  {
    "path": "TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Loop.lean",
    "name": "Turing.FinTM.loopHostTM_finds",
    "private": false,
    "statement": "theorem loopHostTM_finds (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (Inv : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 Prop) (stepF : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (acceptF : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 Bool) (out : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (s0 : List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (R T : \u2115 \u2192 \u2115) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T) (hInv0 : \u2200 x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x)) (hInvStep : \u2200 (x s : List Bool), Inv x s \u2192 Inv x (stepF x s)) (hstart : \u2200 x : List Bool, \u2203 t \u2264 T x.length, (\u2200 t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state \u2260 some anchor) \u2227 body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x))) (hround : \u2200 (x s : List Bool), Inv x s \u2192 \u2203 t, 0 < t \u2227 t \u2264 T x.length \u2227 (\u2200 t', 0 < t' \u2192 t' < t \u2192 (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state \u2260 some anchor) \u2227 if acceptF x s then (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none \u2227 (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = out x s else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) : (loopHostTM body F anchor true).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => match (List.range (R x.length + 1)).find? (fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))) with | some i => out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) | none => []) (fun n => 10 * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2))"

    "statement": "theorem loopHostTM_spaceUsed_le_budget (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (Inv : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 Prop) (stepF : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (acceptF : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 Bool) (out : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (findMode : Bool) (s0 : List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (R T : \u2115 \u2192 \u2115) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T) (hInv0 : \u2200 x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x)) (hInvStep : \u2200 (x s : List Bool), Inv x s \u2192 Inv x (stepF x s)) (hstart : \u2200 x : List Bool, \u2203 t \u2264 T x.length, (\u2200 t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state \u2260 some anchor) \u2227 body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x))) (hround : \u2200 (x s : List Bool), Inv x s \u2192 \u2203 t, 0 < t \u2227 t \u2264 T x.length \u2227 (\u2200 t', 0 < t' \u2192 t' < t \u2192 (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state \u2260 some anchor) \u2227 if acceptF x s then (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none \u2227 (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = out x s else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115) : (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.spaceUsed ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 23 * (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).k * (T x.length + 1)"

## ===== campaign/fills/mig1/inputs/forwarding-map-contract.lean.txt =====

-- Historical statement-gated additions, not existing exports at the fill base.
-- fwdMapTM denotes the private forwarding controller moved from Catalog a2_mapTM.
-- Treat this as contract data; the worker supplies complete proofs.
namespace Turing.FinTM

/-- **The threaded map** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.pairMapSndTM`, new in `Primitives` at the fill
stage, when the forwarding-controller family moves from Catalog; the body is the witness of
today's `computesFunInTime_pairMapSnd_spaceUsed`, `Build/Catalog.lean:5901`). On
`pairEncode a b` it validates the pair while buffering both components on two work tapes,
emits the encoding of `a` followed by the separator, and then runs `Mg` on the buffered `b`
through clamped virtual input, forwarding `Mg`'s emissions, so that it outputs
`pairEncode a (g b)`; a malformed input gives `[]`. It replaces the captured-payload
`pairMapTM` of `Primitives`, whose capture tape cannot carry a linear space bound
(consolidation). -/
def pairMapSndTM (Mg : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool := fwdMapTM Mg true

/-- **The threaded map's time** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.pairMapSndTM_computes`, new in
`Primitives` before `computesFunInTime_pairMapSnd`). If `Mg` computes `g` within a monotone
`Tg`, the threaded map computes `pairEncode a b ↦ pairEncode a (g b)` (and `[]` off the
encodings) within `22·(n + 1 + Tg n)` steps.

**Proof sketch.** The time half of Catalog's `computesFunInTime_pairMapSnd_spaceUsed`: rejection
and the launch of the payload each take at most `5·(n + 1)` steps (`a2_map_reject`,
`a2_map_launch`, moved); the forwarded payload then runs `Tg |b|` steps in lockstep
(`a2_mapVirtual_run`), and `|b| ≤ n` with monotonicity gives `Tg n`. -/
theorem pairMapSndTM_computes {Mg : FinTM Bool} {g : List Bool → List Bool} {Tg : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hg : Mg.ComputesFunInTime g Tg) (hTg : Monotone Tg) :
    (pairMapSndTM Mg).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun z => match pairDecode z with
        | some (a, b) => pairEncode a (g b)
        | none => [])
      (fun n => 22 * (n + 1 + Tg n)) := by
  sorry

/-- **The threaded map's space** (landing: `Turing.FinTM.pairMapSndTM_spaceUsed`, new in
`Primitives` after `pairMapSndTM_computes`). If `Mg` uses at most `Sg |y|` work cells on every
input `y` at every time, with `Sg` monotone, then the threaded map uses at most
`Sg |x| + 22·(|x| + 1)` cells: coefficient one on the payload's space, plus linear
administration. No time hypothesis is needed.

**Proof sketch.** The space half of the same Catalog row (`a2_map_space`, moved): the two
buffer heads stay in `[-5(n + 1), 5(n + 1)]`, and each payload tape's visited set is contained
in `Mg`'s own on `b` (or on `x`, after a rejection, where the payload bank never moves), which
`Sg |b| ≤ Sg |x|` bounds; the total is `Sg |x| + 2·(10(n + 1) + 1)`. -/
theorem pairMapSndTM_spaceUsed {Mg : FinTM Bool} (Sg : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hgs : ∀ (y : List Bool) (t : ℕ), Mg.tm.spaceUsed (Mg.tm.initCfg y) t ≤ Sg y.length)
    (hSg : Monotone Sg) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (pairMapSndTM Mg).tm.spaceUsed ((pairMapSndTM Mg).tm.initCfg x) t ≤
      Sg x.length + 22 * (x.length + 1) := by
  sorry

end Turing.FinTM

    "Turing.Cfg.ofWords_copy_endpoint": "theorem Cfg.ofWords_copy_endpoint {k : \u2115} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool} (q q' : S) (w : Fin k \u2192 List Bool) (src dst : Fin k) (hdst : w dst = []) : ({ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w) with state := some q' workTapes := fun j p => if j = dst \u2227 (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j \u2264 p \u2227 p < (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j + ((w src).length : \u2124) then FinTM.bufferTape (w src) (p - (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j) else (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapes j p } : Cfg k Bool S x) = Cfg.ofWords q' (Function.update w dst (w src))",
    "Turing.Cfg.ofWords_transfer_endpoint": "theorem Cfg.ofWords_transfer_endpoint {k : \u2115} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool} (q q' : S) (w : Fin k \u2192 List Bool) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src \u2260 dst) (hdst : w dst = []) : ({ (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w) with state := some q' workTapes := fun j p => if j = src \u2227 (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j \u2264 p \u2227 p < (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j + ((w src).length : \u2124) then none else if j = dst \u2227 (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j \u2264 p \u2227 p < (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j + ((w src).length : \u2124) then FinTM.bufferTape (w src) (p - (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapePos j) else (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q w).workTapes j p } : Cfg k Bool S x) = Cfg.ofWords q' (Function.update (Function.update w src []) dst (w src))",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_cond_spaceUsed {D M\u2081 M\u2082 : FinTM Bool} {p : List Bool \u2192 Bool} {f\u2081 f\u2082 : List Bool \u2192 List Bool} {T\u2080 T\u2081 T\u2082 : \u2115 \u2192 \u2115} (sD s\u2081 s\u2082 : \u2115 \u2192 \u2115) (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T\u2080) (h\u2081 : M\u2081.ComputesFunInTime f\u2081 T\u2081) (h\u2082 : M\u2082.ComputesFunInTime f\u2082 T\u2082) (hsD : \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), D.tm.spaceUsed (D.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 sD x.length) (hs\u2081 : \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M\u2081.tm.spaceUsed (M\u2081.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 s\u2081 x.length) (hs\u2082 : \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M\u2082.tm.spaceUsed (M\u2082.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 s\u2082 x.length) : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => if p x then f\u2081 x else f\u2082 x) (fun n => c * (T\u2080 n + max (T\u2081 n) (T\u2082 n) + 1)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 sD x.length + max (s\u2081 x.length) (s\u2082 x.length) + c",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_const_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_const_spaceUsed (w : List Bool) : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun _ => w) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_id_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_id_spaceUsed : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime id (fun n => c * (n + 1)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_incFixed_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_incFixed_spaceUsed : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => (incFixed x).getD []) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_lengthBits_spaceUsed : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits x.length) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c * (Nat.size x.length + 1)",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairConcat_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_pairConcat_spaceUsed : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun z => match pairDecode z with | some (a, b) => a ++ b | none => []) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c * (x.length + 1)",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairDup_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_pairDup_spaceUsed : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => pairEncode x x) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairEncodeFixed_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_pairEncodeFixed_spaceUsed (\u03b1 : List Bool) : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => pairEncode \u03b1 x) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairFst_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_pairFst_spaceUsed : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => ((pairDecode x).map Prod.fst).getD []) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c * (x.length + 1)",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairLenCheck_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_pairLenCheck_spaceUsed (C e : \u2115) : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [match pairDecode x with | some (a, b) => decide (b.length \u2264 C * (a.length + 1) ^ e) | none => false]) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c * ((x.length + 1) ^ e + x.length + 1)",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairMapSnd_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_pairMapSnd_spaceUsed {Mg : FinTM Bool} {g : List Bool \u2192 List Bool} {Tg : \u2115 \u2192 \u2115} (Sg : \u2115 \u2192 \u2115) (hg : Mg.ComputesFunInTime g Tg) (hTg : Monotone Tg) (hgs : \u2200 (y : List Bool) (t : \u2115), Mg.tm.spaceUsed (Mg.tm.initCfg y) t \u2264 Sg y.length) (hSg : Monotone Sg) : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun z => match pairDecode z with | some (a, b) => pairEncode a (g b) | none => []) (fun n => c * (n + 1 + Tg n)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 Sg x.length + c * (x.length + 1)",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairSnd_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_pairSnd_spaceUsed : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => ((pairDecode x).map Prod.snd).getD []) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c * (x.length + 1)",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairValid_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_pairValid_spaceUsed : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [(pairDecode x).isSome]) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_polyBits_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_polyBits_spaceUsed (C e : \u2115) : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (C * (x.length + 1) ^ e)) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c * (C * (x.length + 1) ^ e + 1)",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_polyUnary_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_polyUnary_spaceUsed (C e : \u2115) : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ e) true) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c * (x.length + 1)",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_prepend_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_prepend_spaceUsed (w : List Bool) : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => w ++ x) (fun n => c * (n + 1)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_splitSolve_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_splitSolve_spaceUsed (C e : \u2115) : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun w => match solveSplit C e w.length with | some i => pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i) | none => []) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 2)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c * (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1)",
    "Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_stripLast_spaceUsed": "theorem computesFunInTime_stripLast_spaceUsed : \u2203 (M : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => match pairDecode x with | some (a, v) => match splitAtLastTrue v with | some u => pairEncode a u | none => [] | none => []) (fun n => c * (n + 1) ^ 2) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c * (x.length + 1)",
    "Turing.FinTM.exists_loopTM_spaceUsed": "theorem exists_loopTM_spaceUsed (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (Inv : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 Prop) (stepF : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (acceptF : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 Bool) (s0 : List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (R T S : \u2115 \u2192 \u2115) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T) (hInv0 : \u2200 x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x)) (hInvStep : \u2200 (x s : List Bool), Inv x s \u2192 Inv x (stepF x s)) (hstart : \u2200 x : List Bool, \u2203 t \u2264 T x.length, (\u2200 t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state \u2260 some anchor) \u2227 body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x))) (hround : \u2200 (x s : List Bool), Inv x s \u2192 \u2203 t, 0 < t \u2227 t \u2264 T x.length \u2227 (\u2200 t', 0 < t' \u2192 t' < t \u2192 (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state \u2260 some anchor) \u2227 if acceptF x s then (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none \u2227 (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = [true] else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) (hFspace : \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), F.tm.spaceUsed (F.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 S x.length) (hstartSpace : \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), t \u2264 T x.length \u2192 body.tm.spaceUsed (body.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 S x.length) (hroundSpace : \u2200 (x s : List Bool), Inv x s \u2192 \u2200 t \u2264 T x.length, body.tm.spaceUsed (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t \u2264 S x.length) : \u2203 (E : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), E.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [(List.range (R x.length + 1)).any fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))]) (fun n => c * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2)) \u2227 \u2200 (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115), E.tm.spaceUsed (E.tm.initCfg x) t \u2264 c * (S x.length + T x.length + 1)",
    "Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_spaceUsedByTape": "theorem redirectTM_spaceUsedByTape (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : \u2115) (i : Fin M.k) : (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.spaceUsedByTape ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t i = M.tm.spaceUsedByTape (M.tm.initCfg x) t i",
    "Turing.FlagPhase": "inductive FlagPhase",
    "Turing.ScanPhase": "inductive ScanPhase (A : Type)",
    "Turing.SeekPhase": "inductive SeekPhase",
    "Turing.SweepPhase": "inductive SweepPhase",
    "Turing.capture_visitedByTapeHead": "theorem capture_visitedByTapeHead {k : \u2115} {S H : Type*} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (host : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Bool H) (emb : S \u2192 H) (ret : H) (hagree : \u2200 (s : S) (inp : Option Bool) (w : Fin (k + 1) \u2192 Option Bool), host.tr (emb s) inp w = captureAction emb ret (tm.tr s inp fun i => w i.castSucc)) (pre out\u2080 : List Bool) (c\u2080 : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : \u2115) (hlive : \u2200 t' < t, \u00ac(tm.runFrom c\u2080 t').Halted) : (\u2200 i : Fin k, host.visitedByTapeHead (captureCfg emb ret pre out\u2080 c\u2080) t i.castSucc = tm.visitedByTapeHead c\u2080 t i \u2227 host.spaceUsedByTape (captureCfg emb ret pre out\u2080 c\u2080) t i.castSucc = tm.spaceUsedByTape c\u2080 t i) \u2227 host.spaceUsedByTape (captureCfg emb ret pre out\u2080 c\u2080) t (Fin.last k) \u2264 (tm.runFrom c\u2080 t).output.length - c\u2080.output.length + 1",
    "Turing.catalogTrace": "def catalogTrace {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol} {S : Type*} (F R : \u2115 \u2192 Cfg k Symbol S x) (D : Cfg k Symbol S x) (L t : \u2115) : Cfg k Symbol S x",
    "Turing.catalog_trace_run": "theorem catalog_trace_run {Symbol : Type*} {x : List Symbol} {S : Type*} (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol S) (F R : \u2115 \u2192 Cfg k Symbol S x) (D : Cfg k Symbol S x) (L : \u2115) (hF : \u2200 r < L, M.step (F r) = F (r + 1)) (hturn : M.step (F L) = R L) (hR : \u2200 r < L, M.step (R (r + 1)) = R r) (hentry : M.step (R 0) = D) (hD : M.step D = D) (t : \u2115) : M.runFrom (F 0) t = catalogTrace F R D L t",
    "Turing.catalog_write_take": "theorem catalog_write_take {Symbol : Type*} (f : \u2124 \u2192 Option Symbol) (a : \u2124) (w : List Symbol) (r : \u2115) (hr : r < w.length) : Function.update (fun q => if a \u2264 q \u2227 q < a + (r : \u2124) then FinTM.bufferTape w (q - a) else f q) (a + (r : \u2124)) (some w[r]) = (fun q => if a \u2264 q \u2227 q < a + ((r + 1 : \u2115) : \u2124) then FinTM.bufferTape w (q - a) else f q)",
    "Turing.clearTM": "def clearTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : \u2115) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SweepPhase",
    "Turing.clearTM_run": "theorem clearTM_run (k : \u2115) (i : Fin k) (w : Fin k \u2192 List Bool) : \u2203 T \u2264 2 * (w i).length + 2, (\u2200 t < T, ((clearTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t).state \u2260 some SweepPhase.done) \u2227 (clearTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) T = Cfg.ofWords SweepPhase.done (Function.update w i [])",
    "Turing.clearTM_run_ofCfg": "theorem clearTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : \u2115} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep) (hw : \u2200 p : \u2124, -1 \u2264 p \u2192 p \u2264 (w.length : \u2124) \u2192 d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (clearTM k i).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some SweepPhase.done workTapes := fun j q => if j = i \u2227 d.workTapePos j \u2264 q \u2227 q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124) then none else d.workTapes j q } \u2227 (\u2200 t < 2 * w.length + 2, ((clearTM k i).runFrom d t).state \u2260 some SweepPhase.done) \u2227 (\u2200 (j : Fin k) (t : \u2115), t \u2264 2 * w.length + 2 \u2192 if j = i then ((clearTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j \u2208 Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124)) else ((clearTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)",
    "Turing.clearTM_spaceUsedByTape": "theorem clearTM_spaceUsedByTape (k : \u2115) (i : Fin k) (w : Fin k \u2192 List Bool) (t : \u2115) : (clearTM k i).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t i \u2264 (w i).length + 2 \u2227 \u2200 j : Fin k, j \u2260 i \u2192 (clearTM k i).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t j = 1",
    "Turing.compareStop": "def compareStop {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] (u v : List Symbol) : \u2115",
    "Turing.compareStop_cons_cons": "theorem compareStop_cons_cons {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] (a b : Symbol) (u v : List Symbol) : compareStop (a :: u) (b :: v) = if a = b then compareStop u v + 1 else 0",
    "Turing.compareStop_eq": "theorem compareStop_eq {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] (u v : List Symbol) : compareStop u v = ((u.zip v).takeWhile fun p => decide (p.1 = p.2)).length",
    "Turing.compareStop_le": "theorem compareStop_le {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] (u v : List Symbol) : compareStop u v \u2264 min u.length v.length",
    "Turing.compareStop_spec": "theorem compareStop_spec {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] (u v : List Symbol) : (\u2200 r < compareStop u v, \u2203 b, u[r]? = some b \u2227 v[r]? = some b) \u2227 \u00ac\u2203 b, u[compareStop u v]? = some b \u2227 v[compareStop u v]? = some b",
    "Turing.compareStop_unique": "theorem compareStop_unique {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] {u v : List Symbol} {d : \u2115} (h1 : \u2200 r < d, \u2203 b, u[r]? = some b \u2227 v[r]? = some b) (h2 : \u00ac\u2203 b, u[d]? = some b \u2227 v[d]? = some b) : d = compareStop u v",
    "Turing.compareTM": "def compareTM {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] (k : \u2115) (fst snd : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol FlagPhase",
    "Turing.compareTM_run": "theorem compareTM_run (k : \u2115) (fst snd : Fin k) (w : Fin k \u2192 List Bool) : \u2203 T \u2264 2 * min (w fst).length (w snd).length + 2, (\u2200 t < T, \u2200 v : Bool, ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t).state \u2260 some (FlagPhase.done v)) \u2227 (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) T = Cfg.ofWords (FlagPhase.done (decide (w fst = w snd))) w",
    "Turing.compareTM_run_ofCfg": "theorem compareTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] {k : \u2115} {x : List Symbol} (fst snd : Fin k) (hne : fst \u2260 snd) (u v : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run) (hu : \u2200 p : \u2124, -1 \u2264 p \u2192 p \u2264 (u.length : \u2124) \u2192 d.workTapes fst (d.workTapePos fst + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p) (hv : \u2200 p : \u2124, -1 \u2264 p \u2192 p \u2264 (v.length : \u2124) \u2192 d.workTapes snd (d.workTapePos snd + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p) : \u2203 \u03b4 \u2264 min u.length v.length, (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d (2 * \u03b4 + 2) = { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done (decide (u = v))) } \u2227 (\u2200 t < 2 * \u03b4 + 2, \u2200 b, ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).state \u2260 some (FlagPhase.done b)) \u2227 (\u2200 (j : Fin k) (t : \u2115), t \u2264 2 * \u03b4 + 2 \u2192 if j = fst \u2228 j = snd then ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j \u2208 Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (\u03b4 : \u2124)) else ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)",
    "Turing.compareTM_run_stop_ofCfg": "theorem compareTM_run_stop_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} [DecidableEq Symbol] {k : \u2115} {x : List Symbol} (fst snd : Fin k) (hne : fst \u2260 snd) (u v : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run) (hu : \u2200 p : \u2124, -1 \u2264 p \u2192 p \u2264 (u.length : \u2124) \u2192 d.workTapes fst (d.workTapePos fst + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p) (hv : \u2200 p : \u2124, -1 \u2264 p \u2192 p \u2264 (v.length : \u2124) \u2192 d.workTapes snd (d.workTapePos snd + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p) : (compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d (2 * compareStop u v + 2) = { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done (decide (u = v))) } \u2227 (\u2200 t < 2 * compareStop u v + 2, \u2200 b, ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).state \u2260 some (FlagPhase.done b)) \u2227 (\u2200 (j : Fin k) (t : \u2115), t \u2264 2 * compareStop u v + 2 \u2192 if j = fst \u2228 j = snd then ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j \u2208 Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (compareStop u v : \u2124)) else ((compareTM k fst snd).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)",
    "Turing.compareTM_spaceUsedByTape": "theorem compareTM_spaceUsedByTape (k : \u2115) (fst snd : Fin k) (w : Fin k \u2192 List Bool) (t : \u2115) : (compareTM k fst snd).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t fst \u2264 min (w fst).length (w snd).length + 2 \u2227 (compareTM k fst snd).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t snd \u2264 min (w fst).length (w snd).length + 2 \u2227 \u2200 j : Fin k, j \u2260 fst \u2192 j \u2260 snd \u2192 (compareTM k fst snd).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t j = 1",
    "Turing.copyMapTM": "def copyMapTM {Symbol : Type*} {\u0394 : Type*} (k : \u2115) (src dst : Fin k) (extract : Symbol \u2192 \u0394) (merge : Option Symbol \u2192 \u0394 \u2192 Symbol) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SweepPhase",
    "Turing.copyMapTM_plain": "theorem copyMapTM_plain {Symbol : Type*} (k : \u2115) (src dst : Fin k) : copyMapTM k src dst (id : Symbol \u2192 Symbol) (fun _ s => s) = copyTM k src dst",
    "Turing.copyMapTM_run_ofCfg": "theorem copyMapTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {\u0394 : Type*} {k : \u2115} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src \u2260 dst) (extract : Symbol \u2192 \u0394) (merge : Option Symbol \u2192 \u0394 \u2192 Symbol) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep) (hw : \u2200 p : \u2124, -1 \u2264 p \u2192 p \u2264 (w.length : \u2124) \u2192 d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (copyMapTM k src dst extract merge).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some SweepPhase.done workTapes := fun j q => if j = dst \u2227 d.workTapePos j \u2264 q \u2227 q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124) then (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)).map fun \u03b3 => merge (d.workTapes j q) (extract \u03b3) else d.workTapes j q } \u2227 (\u2200 t < 2 * w.length + 2, ((copyMapTM k src dst extract merge).runFrom d t).state \u2260 some SweepPhase.done) \u2227 (\u2200 (j : Fin k) (t : \u2115), t \u2264 2 * w.length + 2 \u2192 if j = src \u2228 j = dst then ((copyMapTM k src dst extract merge).runFrom d t).workTapePos j \u2208 Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124)) else ((copyMapTM k src dst extract merge).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)",
    "Turing.copyTM": "def copyTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : \u2115) (src dst : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SweepPhase",
    "Turing.copyTM_run": "theorem copyTM_run (k : \u2115) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src \u2260 dst) (w : Fin k \u2192 List Bool) (hdst : w dst = []) : \u2203 T \u2264 3 * (w src).length + 3, (\u2200 t < T, ((copyTM k src dst).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t).state \u2260 some SweepPhase.done) \u2227 (copyTM k src dst).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) T = Cfg.ofWords SweepPhase.done (Function.update w dst (w src))",
    "Turing.copyTM_run_ofCfg": "theorem copyTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : \u2115} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src \u2260 dst) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep) (hw : \u2200 p : \u2124, -1 \u2264 p \u2192 p \u2264 (w.length : \u2124) \u2192 d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (copyTM k src dst).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some SweepPhase.done workTapes := fun j q => if j = dst \u2227 d.workTapePos j \u2264 q \u2227 q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124) then FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j q } \u2227 (\u2200 t < 2 * w.length + 2, ((copyTM k src dst).runFrom d t).state \u2260 some SweepPhase.done) \u2227 (\u2200 (j : Fin k) (t : \u2115), t \u2264 2 * w.length + 2 \u2192 if j = src \u2228 j = dst then ((copyTM k src dst).runFrom d t).workTapePos j \u2208 Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124)) else ((copyTM k src dst).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)",
    "Turing.copyTM_spaceUsedByTape": "theorem copyTM_spaceUsedByTape (k : \u2115) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src \u2260 dst) (w : Fin k \u2192 List Bool) (hdst : w dst = []) (t : \u2115) : (copyTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t src \u2264 (w src).length + 2 \u2227 (copyTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t dst \u2264 (w src).length + 2 \u2227 \u2200 j : Fin k, j \u2260 src \u2192 j \u2260 dst \u2192 (copyTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t j = 1",
    "Turing.fieldOffset": "def fieldOffset {\u0393 : Type*} (fs : List (List \u0393)) (j : \u2115) : \u2115",
    "Turing.fieldOffset_add_length_le": "theorem fieldOffset_add_length_le {\u0393 : Type*} (fs : List (List \u0393)) (j : \u2115) (hj : j < fs.length) : fieldOffset fs j + fs[j].length \u2264 (joinFields fs).length",
    "Turing.fieldOffset_cons_succ": "theorem fieldOffset_cons_succ {\u0393 : Type*} (u : List \u0393) (fs : List (List \u0393)) (j : \u2115) : fieldOffset (u :: fs) (j + 1) = u.length + 1 + fieldOffset fs j",
    "Turing.fieldOffset_succ": "theorem fieldOffset_succ {\u0393 : Type*} (fs : List (List \u0393)) (j : \u2115) (hj : j < fs.length) : fieldOffset fs (j + 1) = fieldOffset fs j + (fs[j].length + 1)",
    "Turing.fieldOffset_zero": "theorem fieldOffset_zero {\u0393 : Type*} (fs : List (List \u0393)) : fieldOffset fs 0 = 0",
    "Turing.fieldsTape": "def fieldsTape {\u0393 : Type*} (fs : List (List \u0393)) (z : \u2124) : Option \u0393",
    "Turing.fieldsTape_cons_shift": "theorem fieldsTape_cons_shift {\u0393 : Type*} (u v : List \u0393) (fs : List (List \u0393)) (z : \u2124) (hz : -1 \u2264 z) : fieldsTape (u :: v :: fs) ((u.length : \u2124) + 1 + z) = fieldsTape (v :: fs) z",
    "Turing.fieldsTape_field": "theorem fieldsTape_field {\u0393 : Type*} (fs : List (List \u0393)) (j : \u2115) (hj : j < fs.length) : \u2200 p : \u2124, -1 \u2264 p \u2192 p \u2264 (fs[j].length : \u2124) \u2192 fieldsTape fs (fieldOffset fs j + p) = FinTM.bufferTape fs[j] p",
    "Turing.fieldsTape_nil": "theorem fieldsTape_nil {\u0393 : Type*} (z : \u2124) : fieldsTape ([] : List (List \u0393)) z = none",
    "Turing.fieldsTape_of_length_le": "theorem fieldsTape_of_length_le {\u0393 : Type*} (fs : List (List \u0393)) {z : \u2124} (hz : ((joinFields fs).length : \u2124) \u2264 z) : fieldsTape fs z = none",
    "Turing.fieldsTape_of_neg": "theorem fieldsTape_of_neg {\u0393 : Type*} (fs : List (List \u0393)) {z : \u2124} (hz : z < 0) : fieldsTape fs z = none",
    "Turing.fieldsTape_of_nonneg": "theorem fieldsTape_of_nonneg {\u0393 : Type*} (fs : List (List \u0393)) {z : \u2124} (hz : 0 \u2264 z) : fieldsTape fs z = ((joinFields fs)[z.toNat]?).join",
    "Turing.incrementTM": "def incrementTM (k : \u2115) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool FlagPhase",
    "Turing.incrementTM_run_overflow": "theorem incrementTM_run_overflow (k : \u2115) (i : Fin k) (w : Fin k \u2192 List Bool) (hv : incFixed (w i) = none) : \u2203 T \u2264 2 * (w i).length + 2, (\u2200 t < T, \u2200 b : Bool, ((incrementTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t).state \u2260 some (FlagPhase.done b)) \u2227 (incrementTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) T = Cfg.ofWords (FlagPhase.done false) (Function.update w i (List.replicate (w i).length false))",
    "Turing.incrementTM_run_overflow_ofCfg": "theorem incrementTM_run_overflow_ofCfg {k : \u2115} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (w : List Bool) (hv : incFixed w = none) (d : Cfg k Bool FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run) (hw : \u2200 p : \u2124, -1 \u2264 p \u2192 p \u2264 (w.length : \u2124) \u2192 d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (incrementTM k i).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done false) workTapes := fun j q => if j = i \u2227 d.workTapePos j \u2264 q \u2227 q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124) then FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate w.length false) (q - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j q } \u2227 (\u2200 t < 2 * w.length + 2, \u2200 b : Bool, ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).state \u2260 some (FlagPhase.done b)) \u2227 (\u2200 (j : Fin k) (t : \u2115), t \u2264 2 * w.length + 2 \u2192 if j = i then ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j \u2208 Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124)) else ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)",
    "Turing.incrementTM_run_succ": "theorem incrementTM_run_succ (k : \u2115) (i : Fin k) (w : Fin k \u2192 List Bool) (v : List Bool) (hv : incFixed (w i) = some v) : \u2203 T \u2264 2 * (w i).length + 2, (\u2200 t < T, \u2200 b : Bool, ((incrementTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t).state \u2260 some (FlagPhase.done b)) \u2227 (incrementTM k i).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) T = Cfg.ofWords (FlagPhase.done true) (Function.update w i v)",
    "Turing.incrementTM_run_succ_ofCfg": "theorem incrementTM_run_succ_ofCfg {k : \u2115} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin k) (w v : List Bool) (hv : incFixed w = some v) (d : Cfg k Bool FlagPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some FlagPhase.run) (hw : \u2200 p : \u2124, -1 \u2264 p \u2192 p \u2264 (w.length : \u2124) \u2192 d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (incrementTM k i).runFrom d (2 * (w.takeWhile id).length + 2) = { d with state := some (FlagPhase.done true) workTapes := fun j q => if j = i \u2227 d.workTapePos j \u2264 q \u2227 q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124) then FinTM.bufferTape v (q - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j q } \u2227 (\u2200 t < 2 * (w.takeWhile id).length + 2, \u2200 b : Bool, ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).state \u2260 some (FlagPhase.done b)) \u2227 (\u2200 (j : Fin k) (t : \u2115), t \u2264 2 * (w.takeWhile id).length + 2 \u2192 if j = i then ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j \u2208 Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ((w.takeWhile id).length : \u2124)) else ((incrementTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)",
    "Turing.incrementTM_spaceUsedByTape": "theorem incrementTM_spaceUsedByTape (k : \u2115) (i : Fin k) (w : Fin k \u2192 List Bool) (t : \u2115) : (incrementTM k i).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t i \u2264 (w i).length + 2 \u2227 \u2200 j : Fin k, j \u2260 i \u2192 (incrementTM k i).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) FlagPhase.run w) t j = 1",
    "Turing.inputMoveAction": "def inputMoveAction {k : \u2115} {Symbol State : Type*} (inp : SignType) (q : State) : Action k Symbol State",
    "Turing.joinFields": "def joinFields {\u0393 : Type*} (fs : List (List \u0393)) : List (Option \u0393)",
    "Turing.joinFields_cons_cons": "theorem joinFields_cons_cons {\u0393 : Type*} (u v : List \u0393) (fs : List (List \u0393)) : joinFields (u :: v :: fs) = u.map some ++ none :: joinFields (v :: fs)",
    "Turing.joinFields_nil": "theorem joinFields_nil {\u0393 : Type*} : joinFields ([] : List (List \u0393)) = []",
    "Turing.joinFields_singleton": "theorem joinFields_singleton {\u0393 : Type*} (u : List \u0393) : joinFields [u] = u.map some",
    "Turing.length_joinFields_add_one": "theorem length_joinFields_add_one {\u0393 : Type*} (fs : List (List \u0393)) (hfs : fs \u2260 []) : (joinFields fs).length + 1 = fieldOffset fs fs.length",
    "Turing.mealyRun": "def mealyRun {A \u0393 : Type*} (\u03b4 : A \u2192 \u0393 \u2192 A \u00d7 \u0393) : A \u2192 List \u0393 \u2192 A \u00d7 List \u0393",
    "Turing.scanCarry": "def scanCarry {\u0393 : Type*} (top : \u0393 \u2192 Bool) (next : \u0393 \u2192 \u0393) : Bool \u2192 \u0393 \u2192 Bool \u00d7 \u0393",
    "Turing.scanFold": "def scanFold {A \u0393 : Type*} (\u03b4 : A \u2192 \u0393 \u2192 A) : A \u2192 \u0393 \u2192 A \u00d7 \u0393",
    "Turing.scanKeep": "def scanKeep {A \u0393 : Type*} : A \u2192 \u0393 \u2192 A \u00d7 \u0393",
    "Turing.scanMap": "def scanMap {A \u0393 : Type*} (f : \u0393 \u2192 \u0393) : A \u2192 \u0393 \u2192 A \u00d7 \u0393",
    "Turing.scanResult": "def scanResult {A \u0393 : Type*} (\u03b4f \u03b4b : A \u2192 \u0393 \u2192 A \u00d7 \u0393) (a\u2080 : A) (w : List \u0393) : A \u00d7 List \u0393",
    "Turing.scanResult_carry": "theorem scanResult_carry {\u0393 : Type*} (top : \u0393 \u2192 Bool) (next : \u0393 \u2192 \u0393) (w : List \u0393) : scanResult (scanCarry top next) scanKeep true w = (w.all top, (w.takeWhile top).map next ++ ((w.dropWhile top).take 1).map next ++ (w.dropWhile top).drop 1)",
    "Turing.scanResult_fold": "theorem scanResult_fold {A \u0393 : Type*} (\u03b4 : A \u2192 \u0393 \u2192 A) (a\u2080 : A) (w : List \u0393) : scanResult (scanFold \u03b4) scanKeep a\u2080 w = (w.foldl \u03b4 a\u2080, w)",
    "Turing.scanResult_keep_keep": "theorem scanResult_keep_keep {A \u0393 : Type*} (a\u2080 : A) (w : List \u0393) : scanResult scanKeep scanKeep a\u2080 w = (a\u2080, w)",
    "Turing.scanResult_map": "theorem scanResult_map {A \u0393 : Type*} (f : \u0393 \u2192 \u0393) (a\u2080 : A) (w : List \u0393) : scanResult (scanMap f) scanKeep a\u2080 w = (a\u2080, w.map f)",
    "Turing.scanResult_shiftLeft": "theorem scanResult_shiftLeft {B \u0393 : Type*} (get : \u0393 \u2192 B) (set : \u0393 \u2192 B \u2192 \u0393) (b\u2080 : B) (w : List \u0393) : scanResult scanKeep (scanShift get set) b\u2080 w = ((w.map get).head?.getD b\u2080, List.zipWith set w (w.tail.map get ++ [b\u2080]))",
    "Turing.scanResult_shiftRight": "theorem scanResult_shiftRight {B \u0393 : Type*} (get : \u0393 \u2192 B) (set : \u0393 \u2192 B \u2192 \u0393) (b\u2080 : B) (w : List \u0393) : scanResult (scanShift get set) scanKeep b\u2080 w = ((w.map get).getLast?.getD b\u2080, List.zipWith set w (b\u2080 :: w.map get))",
    "Turing.scanShift": "def scanShift {B \u0393 : Type*} (get : \u0393 \u2192 B) (set : \u0393 \u2192 B \u2192 \u0393) : B \u2192 \u0393 \u2192 B \u00d7 \u0393",
    "Turing.scanTM": "def scanTM {\u0393 : Type*} {A : Type} (k : \u2115) (i : Fin k) (\u03b4f \u03b4b : A \u2192 \u0393 \u2192 A \u00d7 \u0393) (a\u2080 : A) : MultiTapeTM k \u0393 (ScanPhase A)",
    "Turing.scanTM_run_ofCfg": "theorem scanTM_run_ofCfg {\u0393 : Type*} {A : Type} {k : \u2115} {x : List \u0393} (i : Fin k) (\u03b4f \u03b4b : A \u2192 \u0393 \u2192 A \u00d7 \u0393) (a\u2080 : A) (w : List \u0393) (d : Cfg k \u0393 (ScanPhase A) x) (hstate : d.state = some (.fwd a\u2080)) (hw : \u2200 p : \u2124, -1 \u2264 p \u2192 p \u2264 (w.length : \u2124) \u2192 d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (scanTM k i \u03b4f \u03b4b a\u2080).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some (.done (scanResult \u03b4f \u03b4b a\u2080 w).1) workTapes := fun j q => if j = i \u2227 d.workTapePos j \u2264 q \u2227 q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124) then FinTM.bufferTape (scanResult \u03b4f \u03b4b a\u2080 w).2 (q - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j q } \u2227 (\u2200 t < 2 * w.length + 2, \u2200 a, ((scanTM k i \u03b4f \u03b4b a\u2080).runFrom d t).state \u2260 some (.done a)) \u2227 (\u2200 (j : Fin k) (t : \u2115), t \u2264 2 * w.length + 2 \u2192 if j = i then ((scanTM k i \u03b4f \u03b4b a\u2080).runFrom d t).workTapePos j \u2208 Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124)) else ((scanTM k i \u03b4f \u03b4b a\u2080).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)",
    "Turing.seekEndTM": "def seekEndTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : \u2115) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SeekPhase",
    "Turing.seekEndTM_run_ofCfg": "theorem seekEndTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : \u2115} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (ws : List (List Symbol)) (hne : ws \u2260 []) (hws : \u2200 u \u2208 ws, u \u2260 []) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run) (hw : \u2200 p : \u2124, 0 \u2264 p \u2192 p \u2264 (fieldOffset ws ws.length : \u2124) \u2192 d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = fieldsTape ws p) : (seekEndTM k i).runFrom d (fieldOffset ws ws.length + 1) = { d with state := some .done workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + fieldOffset ws ws.length) } \u2227 (\u2200 t < fieldOffset ws ws.length + 1, ((seekEndTM k i).runFrom d t).state \u2260 some .done) \u2227 (\u2200 (j : Fin k) (t : \u2115), t \u2264 fieldOffset ws ws.length + 1 \u2192 if j = i then ((seekEndTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j \u2208 Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + fieldOffset ws ws.length) else ((seekEndTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)",
    "Turing.seekStartTM": "def seekStartTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : \u2115) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SeekPhase",
    "Turing.seekStartTM_run_ofCfg": "theorem seekStartTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : \u2115} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (ws : List (List Symbol)) (hws : \u2200 u \u2208 ws, u \u2260 []) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run) (hcur : d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i) \u2260 none) (hw : \u2200 p : \u2124, -2 \u2264 p \u2192 p < (fieldOffset ws ws.length : \u2124) \u2192 d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - fieldOffset ws ws.length + p) = fieldsTape ws p) : (seekStartTM k i).runFrom d (fieldOffset ws ws.length + 4) = { d with state := some .done workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i - fieldOffset ws ws.length) } \u2227 (\u2200 t < fieldOffset ws ws.length + 4, ((seekStartTM k i).runFrom d t).state \u2260 some .done) \u2227 (\u2200 (j : Fin k) (t : \u2115), t \u2264 fieldOffset ws ws.length + 4 \u2192 if j = i then ((seekStartTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j \u2208 Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - fieldOffset ws ws.length - 2) (d.workTapePos j) else ((seekStartTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)",
    "Turing.skipBackTM": "def skipBackTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : \u2115) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SeekPhase",
    "Turing.skipBackTM_run_ofCfg": "theorem skipBackTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : \u2115} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (u : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run) (hu : \u2200 p : \u2124, -1 \u2264 p \u2192 p \u2264 (u.length : \u2124) \u2192 d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - u.length - 1 + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p) : (skipBackTM k i).runFrom d (u.length + 3) = { d with state := some .done workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i - u.length - 1) } \u2227 (\u2200 t < u.length + 3, ((skipBackTM k i).runFrom d t).state \u2260 some .done) \u2227 (\u2200 (j : Fin k) (t : \u2115), t \u2264 u.length + 3 \u2192 if j = i then ((skipBackTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j \u2208 Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - u.length - 2) (d.workTapePos j) else ((skipBackTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)",
    "Turing.skipTM": "def skipTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : \u2115) (i : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SeekPhase",
    "Turing.skipTM_eq_walkTM": "theorem skipTM_eq_walkTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : \u2115) (i : Fin k) : (skipTM k i : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SeekPhase) = walkTM k i (\u00b7 = i) .pos",
    "Turing.skipTM_run_ofCfg": "theorem skipTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : \u2115} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run) (hw : \u2200 p : \u2124, 0 \u2264 p \u2192 p \u2264 (w.length : \u2124) \u2192 d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (skipTM k i).runFrom d (w.length + 1) = { d with state := some .done workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + w.length + 1) } \u2227 (\u2200 t < w.length + 1, ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).state \u2260 some .done) \u2227 (\u2200 (j : Fin k) (t : \u2115), t \u2264 w.length + 1 \u2192 if j = i then ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j \u2208 Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + w.length + 1) else ((skipTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)",
    "Turing.step_of_inputMoveAction": "theorem step_of_inputMoveAction {Symbol State : Type*} {k : \u2115} {x : List Symbol} (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) {q q' : State} (inp : SignType) (hq : c.state = some q) (htr : M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols = inputMoveAction inp q') : M.step c = { c with state := some q', inputPos := moveInputPos c.inputPos inp }",
    "Turing.step_of_tapeAction_move": "theorem step_of_tapeAction_move {Symbol State : Type*} {k : \u2115} {x : List Symbol} (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) {q q' : State} (i : Fin k) (inp m : SignType) (hq : c.state = some q) (htr : M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols = tapeAction i inp none m q') : M.step c = { c with state := some q' inputPos := moveInputPos c.inputPos inp workTapePos := Function.update c.workTapePos i (c.workTapePos i + m) }",
    "Turing.step_of_tapeAction_write": "theorem step_of_tapeAction_write {Symbol State : Type*} {k : \u2115} {x : List Symbol} (M : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) {q q' : State} (i : Fin k) (inp : SignType) (s : Option Symbol) (m : SignType) (hq : c.state = some q) (htr : M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols = tapeAction i inp (some s) m q') : M.step c = { c with state := some q' inputPos := moveInputPos c.inputPos inp workTapes := Function.update c.workTapes i (Function.update (c.workTapes i) (c.workTapePos i) s) workTapePos := Function.update c.workTapePos i (c.workTapePos i + m) }",
    "Turing.tapeAction": "def tapeAction {k : \u2115} {Symbol State : Type*} (i : Fin k) (inp : SignType) (wr : Option (Option Symbol)) (m : SignType) (q : State) : Action k Symbol State",
    "Turing.transferMapTM": "def transferMapTM {Symbol : Type*} {\u0394 : Type*} (k : \u2115) (src dst : Fin k) (extract : Symbol \u2192 \u0394) (merge : Option Symbol \u2192 \u0394 \u2192 Symbol) (rest : Symbol \u2192 Option Symbol) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SweepPhase",
    "Turing.transferMapTM_plain": "theorem transferMapTM_plain {Symbol : Type*} (k : \u2115) (src dst : Fin k) : transferMapTM k src dst (id : Symbol \u2192 Symbol) (fun _ s => s) (fun _ => none) = transferTM k src dst",
    "Turing.transferMapTM_run_ofCfg": "theorem transferMapTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {\u0394 : Type*} {k : \u2115} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src \u2260 dst) (extract : Symbol \u2192 \u0394) (merge : Option Symbol \u2192 \u0394 \u2192 Symbol) (rest : Symbol \u2192 Option Symbol) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep) (hw : \u2200 p : \u2124, -1 \u2264 p \u2192 p \u2264 (w.length : \u2124) \u2192 d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some SweepPhase.done workTapes := fun j q => if j = src \u2227 d.workTapePos j \u2264 q \u2227 q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124) then (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)).bind rest else if j = dst \u2227 d.workTapePos j \u2264 q \u2227 q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124) then (FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j)).map fun \u03b3 => merge (d.workTapes j q) (extract \u03b3) else d.workTapes j q } \u2227 (\u2200 t < 2 * w.length + 2, ((transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t).state \u2260 some SweepPhase.done) \u2227 (\u2200 (j : Fin k) (t : \u2115), t \u2264 2 * w.length + 2 \u2192 if j = src \u2228 j = dst then ((transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t).workTapePos j \u2208 Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124)) else ((transferMapTM k src dst extract merge rest).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)",
    "Turing.transferTM": "def transferTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : \u2115) (src dst : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SweepPhase",
    "Turing.transferTM_run": "theorem transferTM_run (k : \u2115) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src \u2260 dst) (w : Fin k \u2192 List Bool) (hdst : w dst = []) : \u2203 T \u2264 3 * (w src).length + 3, (\u2200 t < T, ((transferTM k src dst).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t).state \u2260 some SweepPhase.done) \u2227 (transferTM k src dst).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) T = Cfg.ofWords SweepPhase.done (Function.update (Function.update w src []) dst (w src))",
    "Turing.transferTM_run_ofCfg": "theorem transferTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : \u2115} {x : List Symbol} (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src \u2260 dst) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep) (hw : \u2200 p : \u2124, -1 \u2264 p \u2192 p \u2264 (w.length : \u2124) \u2192 d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (transferTM k src dst).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) = { d with state := some SweepPhase.done workTapes := fun j q => if j = src \u2227 d.workTapePos j \u2264 q \u2227 q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124) then none else if j = dst \u2227 d.workTapePos j \u2264 q \u2227 q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124) then FinTM.bufferTape w (q - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j q } \u2227 (\u2200 t < 2 * w.length + 2, ((transferTM k src dst).runFrom d t).state \u2260 some SweepPhase.done) \u2227 (\u2200 (j : Fin k) (t : \u2115), t \u2264 2 * w.length + 2 \u2192 if j = src \u2228 j = dst then ((transferTM k src dst).runFrom d t).workTapePos j \u2208 Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : \u2124)) else ((transferTM k src dst).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)",
    "Turing.transferTM_spaceUsedByTape": "theorem transferTM_spaceUsedByTape (k : \u2115) (src dst : Fin k) (hne : src \u2260 dst) (w : Fin k \u2192 List Bool) (hdst : w dst = []) (t : \u2115) : (transferTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t src \u2264 (w src).length + 2 \u2227 (transferTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t dst \u2264 (w src).length + 2 \u2227 \u2200 j : Fin k, j \u2260 src \u2192 j \u2260 dst \u2192 (transferTM k src dst).spaceUsedByTape (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) SweepPhase.sweep w) t j = 1",
    "Turing.walkTM": "def walkTM {Symbol : Type*} (k : \u2115) (src : Fin k) (moved : Fin k \u2192 Prop) [DecidablePred moved] (dir : SignType) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol SeekPhase",
    "Turing.walkTM_run_ofCfg": "theorem walkTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : \u2115} {x : List Symbol} (src : Fin k) (moved : Fin k \u2192 Prop) [DecidablePred moved] (hsrc : moved src) (dir : SignType) (w : List Symbol) (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .run) (hw : \u2200 p : \u2115, p \u2264 w.length \u2192 d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + (dir : \u2124) * p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) : (walkTM k src moved dir).runFrom d (w.length + 1) = { d with state := some .done workTapePos := fun j => d.workTapePos j + if moved j then (dir : \u2124) * ((w.length + 1 : \u2115) : \u2124) else 0 } \u2227 (\u2200 t < w.length + 1, ((walkTM k src moved dir).runFrom d t).state \u2260 some .done) \u2227 (\u2200 (j : Fin k) (t : \u2115), t \u2264 w.length + 1 \u2192 ((walkTM k src moved dir).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j + if moved j then (dir : \u2124) * (t : \u2124) else 0)"
  },
  "TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/CertShell.lean": {
    "Turing.FinTM.certificateShell_proj": "theorem FinTM.certificateShell_proj (C c : \u2115) (out : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 List Bool) : {x : List Bool | \u2203 u, u.length = C * (x.length + 1) ^ c \u2227 x ++ u \u2208 {y : List Bool | \u2203 x u, y = x ++ u \u2227 u.length = C * (x.length + 1) ^ c \u2227 out x u = [true]}} = {x | \u2203 u, u.length = C * (x.length + 1) ^ c \u2227 out x u = [true]}",
    "Turing.FinTM.exists_certificateShell": "theorem FinTM.exists_certificateShell (P : FinTM Bool) (j : Fin P.k) (C c : \u2115) (out : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (T : \u2115 \u2192 \u2115) (hP : \u2200 x u : List Bool, u.length = C * (x.length + 1) ^ c \u2192 (P.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) P.tm.q\u2080 (Function.update (fun _ => []) j u)) (T (x.length + u.length))).state = none \u2227 (P.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) P.tm.q\u2080 (Function.update (fun _ => []) j u)) (T (x.length + u.length))).output = out x u) : \u2203 (V : FinTM Bool) (b e : \u2115), V.DecidesInTime {y | \u2203 x u, y = x ++ u \u2227 u.length = C * (x.length + 1) ^ c \u2227 out x u = [true]} fun m => b * ((m + 1) ^ e + T m)"
  },
  "TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Loop.lean": {
    "Turing.FinTM.callEntry": "def callEntry (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : (callTM M emit).State",
    "Turing.FinTM.callExit": "def callExit (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : (callTM M emit).State",
    "Turing.FinTM.callTM": "def callTM (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : FinTM Bool",
    "Turing.FinTM.callTM_k_pos": "theorem callTM_k_pos (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : 0 < (callTM M emit).k",
    "Turing.FinTM.callTM_run": "theorem callTM_run (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : \u2115) (hM : M.ComputesInTime arg cap T) : \u2203 t \u2264 (24 + 13 * M.k) * (T + arg.length + cap.length + 1), 0 < t \u2227 (\u2200 j < t, ((callTM M emit).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M emit) (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) j).state \u2260 some (callExit M emit)) \u2227 (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M emit) (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) t = { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callExit M emit) (stateWord (callTM M emit).k (if emit then arg else cap)) with output := if emit then cap else [] }",
    "Turing.FinTM.emitLoopTM": "abbrev emitLoopTM (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) : FinTM Bool",
    "Turing.FinTM.emitLoopTM_computes": "theorem emitLoopTM_computes (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (Inv : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 Prop) (stepF emitF : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (s0 : List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (R T : \u2115 \u2192 \u2115) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T) (hInv0 : \u2200 x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x)) (hInvStep : \u2200 (x s : List Bool), Inv x s \u2192 Inv x (stepF x s)) (hstart : \u2200 x : List Bool, \u2203 t \u2264 T x.length, (\u2200 t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state \u2260 some anchor) \u2227 body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x))) (hround : \u2200 (x s : List Bool), Inv x s \u2192 \u2203 t, 0 < t \u2227 t \u2264 T x.length \u2227 (\u2200 t', 0 < t' \u2192 t' < t \u2192 (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state \u2260 some anchor) \u2227 body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s)) with output := emitF x s }) : (emitLoopTM body F anchor).ComputesFunInTime (fun x => (List.range (R x.length + 1)).flatMap (fun i => emitF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)))) (fun n => 10 * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2))",
    "Turing.FinTM.exists_emitCallTM": "theorem exists_emitCallTM (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (T : \u2115 \u2192 \u2115) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T) : \u2203 (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (c : \u2115), 0 < C.k \u2227 \u2200 (x arg : List Bool), \u2203 t \u2264 c * (T arg.length + arg.length + (f arg).length + 1), 0 < t \u2227 (\u2200 t', 0 < t' \u2192 t' < t \u2192 (C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t').state \u2260 some exit) \u2227 C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t = { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) exit (stateWord C.k arg) with output := f arg }",
    "Turing.FinTM.exists_emitLoopTM": "theorem exists_emitLoopTM (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (Inv : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 Prop) (stepF emitF : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (s0 : List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (R T : \u2115 \u2192 \u2115) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T) (hInv0 : \u2200 x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x)) (hInvStep : \u2200 (x s : List Bool), Inv x s \u2192 Inv x (stepF x s)) (hstart : \u2200 x : List Bool, \u2203 t \u2264 T x.length, (\u2200 t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state \u2260 some anchor) \u2227 body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x))) (hround : \u2200 (x s : List Bool), Inv x s \u2192 \u2203 t, 0 < t \u2227 t \u2264 T x.length \u2227 (\u2200 t', 0 < t' \u2192 t' < t \u2192 (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state \u2260 some anchor) \u2227 body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s)) with output := emitF x s }) : \u2203 (E : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), E.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => (List.range (R x.length + 1)).flatMap (fun i => emitF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)))) (fun n => c * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2))",
    "Turing.FinTM.exists_installCallTM": "theorem exists_installCallTM (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (T : \u2115 \u2192 \u2115) (hM : M.ComputesFunInTime f T) : \u2203 (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (c : \u2115), 0 < C.k \u2227 \u2200 (x arg : List Bool), \u2203 t \u2264 c * (T arg.length + arg.length + (f arg).length + 1), 0 < t \u2227 (\u2200 t', 0 < t' \u2192 t' < t \u2192 (C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t').state \u2260 some exit) \u2227 C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k arg)) t = Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (f arg))",
    "Turing.FinTM.exists_loopCfgTM": "theorem exists_loopCfgTM (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (Inv : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 Prop) (stepF : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (acceptF : List Bool \u2192 List Bool \u2192 Bool) (s0 : List Bool \u2192 List Bool) (R T : \u2115 \u2192 \u2115) (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T) (hInv0 : \u2200 x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x)) (hInvStep : \u2200 (x s : List Bool), Inv x s \u2192 Inv x (stepF x s)) (hstart : \u2200 x : List Bool, \u2203 t \u2264 T x.length, (\u2200 t' < t, (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state \u2260 some anchor) \u2227 body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x))) (hround : \u2200 (x s : List Bool), Inv x s \u2192 \u2203 t, 0 < t \u2227 t \u2264 T x.length \u2227 (\u2200 t', 0 < t' \u2192 t' < t \u2192 (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state \u2260 some anchor) \u2227 if acceptF x s then (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state = none \u2227 (body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output = [true] else body.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t = Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) : \u2203 (E : FinTM Bool) (c : \u2115), \u2200 x : List Bool, \u2203 (cfg : \u2115 \u2192 Cfg E.k Bool E.State x) (startup : \u2115), startup \u2264 c * (T x.length + 1) \u2227 E.tm.runFrom (E.tm.initCfg x) startup = cfg 0 \u2227 (\u2200 i \u2264 R x.length, (cfg i).output = []) \u2227 (cfg (R x.length + 1)).state = none \u2227 (cfg (R x.length + 1)).output = [false] \u2227 (\u2200 i \u2264 R x.length, \u2203 t \u2264 c * (T x.length + 1), if acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) then (E.tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).state = none \u2227 (E.tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).output = [true] else E.tm.runFrom (cfg i) t = cfg (i + 1))",

    "Turing.loop_run": "theorem loop_run {k : \u2115} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : \u2115 \u2192 Cfg k Bool S x) (accept : \u2115 \u2192 Bool) (B N : \u2115) (hout : \u2200 j \u2264 N, (cfg j).output = []) (hend : \u2203 t \u2264 B, (tm.runFrom (cfg N) t).state = none \u2227 (tm.runFrom (cfg N) t).output = [false]) (hround : \u2200 j < N, \u2203 t \u2264 B, if accept j then (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).state = none \u2227 (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).output = [true] else tm.runFrom (cfg j) t = cfg (j + 1)) : \u2203 t \u2264 (N + 1) * B, (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).state = none \u2227 (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).output = [(List.range N).any accept]",

    "Turing.getElem?_dbl": "lemma getElem?_dbl (w : List Bool) (c : \u2115) (hc : c < w.length) (p : Bool) : (dbl w)[2 * c + p.toNat]? = some w[c]",
    "Turing.length_bits_le_self": "lemma length_bits_le_self (m : \u2115) : m.bits.length \u2264 m",
    "Turing.length_dbl": "@[simp] lemma length_dbl (w : List Bool) : (dbl w).length = 2 * w.length",
    "Turing.length_pairEncode": "theorem length_pairEncode (x y : List Bool) : (pairEncode x y).length = 2 * x.length + 2 + y.length",
    "Turing.optBoolBits": "def optBoolBits : Option Bool \u2192 List Bool",
    "Turing.optBoolBits_none": "theorem optBoolBits_none : optBoolBits none = [false, false]",
    "Turing.optBoolBits_some_false": "theorem optBoolBits_some_false : optBoolBits (some false) = [true, false]",
    "Turing.optBoolBits_some_true": "theorem optBoolBits_some_true : optBoolBits (some true) = [true, true]",
    "Turing.optOptBoolBits": "def optOptBoolBits : Option (Option Bool) \u2192 List Bool",
    "Turing.optOptBoolBits_none": "theorem optOptBoolBits_none : optOptBoolBits none = [false, false]",
    "Turing.optOptBoolBits_some_false": "theorem optOptBoolBits_some_false : optOptBoolBits (some (some false)) = [true, false]",
    "Turing.optOptBoolBits_some_none": "theorem optOptBoolBits_some_none : optOptBoolBits (some none) = [false, true]",
    "Turing.optOptBoolBits_some_true": "theorem optOptBoolBits_some_true : optOptBoolBits (some (some true)) = [true, true]",
    "Turing.optStateBits": "def optStateBits {n : \u2115} : Option (Fin n) \u2192 List Bool",
    "Turing.optStateBits_none": "theorem optStateBits_none {n : \u2115} : optStateBits (none : Option (Fin n)) = [false]",
    "Turing.optStateBits_some": "theorem optStateBits_some {n : \u2115} (s : Fin n) : optStateBits (some s) = true :: unaryFin s",
    "Turing.pairDecode": "def pairDecode : List Bool \u2192 Option (List Bool \u00d7 List Bool)",
    "Turing.pairDecode_eq_none": "theorem pairDecode_eq_none (z : List Bool) (h : pairDecode z = none) : \u2203 w tail, z = dbl w ++ tail \u2227 (tail = [] \u2228 (\u2203 b, tail = [b]) \u2228 \u2203 r, tail = true :: false :: r)",
    "Turing.pairDecode_pairEncode": "lemma pairDecode_pairEncode (x \u03b1 : List Bool) : pairDecode (pairEncode x \u03b1) = some (x, \u03b1)",
    "Turing.pairDiagTM": "def pairDiagTM : FinTM Bool",
    "Turing.pairDiagTM_computes": "theorem pairDiagTM_computes (x : List Bool) : pairDiagTM.ComputesInTime x (pairEncode x x) (4 * x.length + 5)",
    "Turing.pairEncode": "def pairEncode (x \u03b1 : List Bool) : List Bool",
    "Turing.pairEncode_eq": "theorem pairEncode_eq (x \u03b1 : List Bool) : pairEncode x \u03b1 = (x.flatMap fun b => [b, b]) ++ [false, true] ++ \u03b1",
    "Turing.pairEncode_eq_dbl": "lemma pairEncode_eq_dbl (x y : List Bool) : pairEncode x y = dbl x ++ [false, true] ++ y",
    "Turing.pairEncode_injective": "theorem pairEncode_injective : Function.Injective fun p : List Bool \u00d7 List Bool => pairEncode p.1 p.2",
    "Turing.pairEncode_replicate_inj": "lemma pairEncode_replicate_inj {n n' : \u2115} {u u' : List Bool} (h : pairEncode (List.replicate n true) u = pairEncode (List.replicate n' true) u') : n = n' \u2227 u = u'",
    "Turing.signBits": "def signBits : SignType \u2192 List Bool",
    "Turing.signBits_neg": "theorem signBits_neg : signBits .neg = [true, true]",
    "Turing.signBits_pos": "theorem signBits_pos : signBits .pos = [true, false]",
    "Turing.signBits_zero": "theorem signBits_zero : signBits .zero = [false, false]",
    "Turing.unaryFin": "def unaryFin {n : \u2115} (s : Fin n) : List Bool",
    "Turing.unaryFin_eq": "theorem unaryFin_eq {n : \u2115} (s : Fin n) : unaryFin s = List.replicate (s : \u2115) true ++ [false]"
