    (w s : List Bool) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hfC : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < a → (C.tm.runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) ce (stateWord C.k s)) j).state ≠ some cx)
    (hrC : C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) ce (stateWord C.k s)) a =
      Cfg.ofWords cx (stateWord C.k (Nat.bits (f s.length))))
    (hfD : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < b → (D.tm.runFrom
      (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) de (stateWord D.k (w.drop s.length))) j).state ≠ some dx)
    (hrD : D.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) de (stateWord D.k (w.drop s.length))) b =
      Cfg.ofWords dx (stateWord D.k (Nat.bits (w.drop s.length).length))) :
    let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D hk hl ce cx de dx
    let z := Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord B.k s)
    ∃ t, 0 < t ∧
      t ≤ a + b + 10 * (s.length + w.length + (Nat.bits (f s.length)).length +
        (Nat.bits (w.drop s.length).length).length + 10) ∧
      (∀ j, 0 < j → j < t → (B.tm.runFrom z j).state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      if emitterSplitAccept f w s then
        (B.tm.runFrom z t).state = none ∧
          (B.tm.runFrom z t).output = pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
      else B.tm.runFrom z t = Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord B.k (splitStep w s)) := by
  sorry
/-- Statement shim of `f2_seamed_space` (`Catalog.lean:8390`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma f2_seamed_space (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (cfg : ℕ → Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (N B H startup : ℕ)
    (hstart : startup ≤ B) (hinit : M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) startup = cfg 0)
    (hseam : ∀ j < N, ∀ i, -(H : ℤ) ≤ (cfg j).workTapePos i ∧
      (cfg j).workTapePos i ≤ H)
    (hend : (cfg N).state = none)
    (hterminal : ∀ i, -((H + B : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (cfg N).workTapePos i ∧
      (cfg N).workTapePos i ≤ (H + B : ℕ))
    (hsegment : ∀ j < N, ∃ u ≤ B,
      (M.tm.runFrom (cfg j) u).state = none ∨ M.tm.runFrom (cfg j) u = cfg (j + 1))
    (t : ℕ) : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ M.k * (2 * (H + B) + 1) := by
  sorry
-- @shim end

-- @shim begin (statement shim: Catalog's private `f2_loopHost_contracts`, re-targeted by the
-- rename `f2_loopHost → loopHostTM`, with its witness `c = f2_loopHost_bound = 10` made explicit:
-- its proof opens with `refine ⟨f2_loopHost_bound, ?_⟩`, `Build/Catalog.lean:8167`)
private lemma loopHost_contracts_heads (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (acceptF : List Bool → List Bool → Bool)
    (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool) (findMode : Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        if acceptF x s then
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).state
              = none ∧
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t).output
              = out x s
        else
          body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))) :
    ∀ x : List Bool,
      ∃ (cfg : ℕ → Cfg (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).k Bool
          (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).State x) (startup : ℕ),
        startup ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1) ∧
        (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
          ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.initCfg x) startup = cfg 0 ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, (cfg i).output = []) ∧
        (cfg (R x.length + 1)).state = none ∧
        (cfg (R x.length + 1)).output = (if findMode then [] else [false]) ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, ∃ t ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1),
          if acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) then
            ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).state = none ∧
            ((loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).output =
              (if findMode then out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)) else [true])
          else (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom (cfg i) t = cfg (i + 1)) ∧
        (∀ i ≤ R x.length, ∀ j,
          -(T x.length : ℤ) ≤ (cfg i).workTapePos j ∧
          (cfg i).workTapePos j ≤ T x.length) ∧
        (∀ j, -((T x.length + 10 * (T x.length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤
          (cfg (R x.length + 1)).workTapePos j ∧
          (cfg (R x.length + 1)).workTapePos j ≤
            (T x.length + 10 * (T x.length + 1) : ℕ)) := by
  sorry
-- @shim end

/-- Probe of `polyUnaryTM_computes`. -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_polyUnaryTM_computes : type_of% @polyUnaryTM_computes := by
  intro C e x
  cases e with
  | zero =>
    simp only [polyUnaryTM, pow_zero, Nat.mul_one]
    exact (constTM_computes (List.replicate C true) x).mono (by simp)
  | succ d => exact catalogPoly_unary_computes d C x

/-- Probe of `pairLenCheckTM_computes`. -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_pairLenCheckTM_computes : type_of% @pairLenCheckTM_computes := by
  intro C e
  have hlen (x : List Bool) : (((pairDecode x).map Prod.fst).getD []).length ≤ x.length := by
    cases hd : pairDecode x with
    | none => simp
    | some ab =>
      rcases ab with ⟨a, b⟩
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.getD_some]
      rw [Turing.eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode x a b hd, length_pairEncode]
      omega
  have hG : (bufferedCompTM (pairExtractTM true false) (polyUnaryTM C e)).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => List.replicate
        (C * ((((pairDecode x).map Prod.fst).getD []).length + 1) ^ e) true)
      (fun n => (C + 5 * e + 12) * ((n + 1) ^ e + n + 1)) := by
    intro x
    have hpow := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.add_le_add_right (hlen x) 1) e
    have h := bufferedCompTM_computesInTime _ _ (pairExtractTM_fst x)
      (polyUnaryTM_computes C e (((pairDecode x).map Prod.fst).getD []))
    refine h.mono ?_
    dsimp only
    have := hlen x
    have h3 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (C + 5 * e + 4) hpow
    generalize (x.length + 1) ^ e = P at h3 ⊢
    generalize ((((pairDecode x).map Prod.fst).getD []).length + 1) ^ e = P' at h3 ⊢
    have h4 : (C + 5 * e + 12) * (P + x.length + 1) =
        (C + 5 * e + 4) * P + 8 * P + (C + 5 * e + 12) * (x.length + 1) := by ring
    have h5 : 8 * (x.length + 1) ≤ (C + 5 * e + 12) * (x.length + 1) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
    omega
  intro x
  have h := pairCount_computes hG x
  have hh : (pairLenCheckTM C e).ComputesInTime x
      [match pairDecode x with
        | some (a, b) => decide (b.length ≤ C * (a.length + 1) ^ e)
        | none => false]
      ((C + 5 * e + 12) * ((x.length + 1) ^ e + x.length + 1) + 2 * x.length + 5) := by
    cases hd : pairDecode x with
    | none => simpa [pairLenCheckTM, hd] using h
    | some uv => cases uv; simpa [pairLenCheckTM, hd] using h
  refine hh.mono ?_
  dsimp only
  generalize (x.length + 1) ^ e = P
  have h6 : (C + 5 * e + 17) * (P + x.length + 1) =
      (C + 5 * e + 12) * (P + x.length + 1) + 5 * (P + x.length + 1) := by ring
  omega

/-- Probe of `stripLastTM_computes`. -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_stripLastTM_computes : type_of% @stripLastTM_computes := by
  have hD := bufferedCompTM_computesFunInTime pairExtractTM_snd anyTrue_computes
    (by intro m n h; exact Nat.add_le_add_right h 1)
  have hE : (constTM []).ComputesFunInTime (fun _ => []) (fun _ => 1) :=
    fun x => constTM_computes [] x
  have hM := timedCondTM_computes (p := fun x => ((pairDecode x).map Prod.snd |>.getD []).any id)
    hD rawStrip_computes hE
  intro x
  have hm := hM x
  have hh : stripLastTM.ComputesInTime x
      (match pairDecode x with
        | some (u, v) => match splitAtLastTrue v with
          | some w => pairEncode u w
          | none => []
        | none => [])
      (5 * (2 * (5 * (x.length + 1) + (5 * (x.length + 1) + 1) + 1) +
        max (4 * (x.length + 1)) 1 + 1)) := by
    cases hd : pairDecode x with
    | none => simpa [stripLastTM, hd] using hm
    | some uv =>
      rcases uv with ⟨u, v⟩
      rcases catalogMarker_cases v with ⟨ha, hs⟩ | ⟨w, ha, hs, hp⟩
      · simpa [stripLastTM, hd, ha, hs] using hm
      · have hx : splitAtLastTrue x = some (pairEncode u w) := by
          rw [Turing.eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode x u v hd]
          exact hp _
        simpa [stripLastTM, hd, ha, hs, hx] using hm
  refine hh.mono ?_
  dsimp only
  have : max (4 * (x.length + 1)) 1 = 4 * (x.length + 1) := max_eq_left (by omega)
  omega

/-- The split-search round contracts in the loop's hypothesis form, for any exact unary source
(today's `splitSolve_source`, with the round budget `(A + 5)·(n + 1)^(e + 1)`). -/
private theorem MIG1Probe.split_hyps (C e : ℕ) (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (B : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hsource : ∀ s : List Bool, M.tm.runFrom (splitBank M s (some start) []) (B s.length) =
      splitBank M s none (List.replicate (C * (s.length + 1) ^ e) true))
    (hbound : ∀ l, B l ≤ (C + 1 + 5 * e) * (l + 1) ^ e + 1) :
    (∀ w : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1),
      (∀ t' < t, ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.initCfg w)
        t').state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      (splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.initCfg w) t =
        Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k [])) ∧
    (∀ (w s : List Bool), s.length ≤ w.length + 1 →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor
            (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k s)) t').state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
        if splitAccept C e w s then
          ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor
            (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k s)) t).state = none ∧
          ((splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor
            (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k s)) t).output =
              pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
        else
          (splitBodyTM M start).tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor
            (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k s)) t =
              Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord (splitBodyTM M start).k (splitStep w s))) := by
  refine ⟨fun w => ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, fun j hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero _),
    splitBody_start M start w⟩, fun w s hs => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨t, htpos, ht, hsafe, hend⟩ := splitBody_round M start w s
    (List.replicate (C * (s.length + 1) ^ e) true) (B s.length) (hsource s)
  refine ⟨t, htpos, (ht.trans (splitBody_envelope C e s.length w.length (B s.length) hs
    (hbound s.length))).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _)), hsafe, ?_⟩
  simpa only [splitAccept, List.length_replicate] using hend

/-- The two exact unary sources of `splitSolveTM` (today's `splitSolve_closed`). -/
private theorem MIG1Probe.split_sources (C e : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (start : M.State) (B : ℕ → ℕ),
      splitSolveTM C e = loopHostTM (splitBodyTM M start) lengthBitsTM .anchor true ∧
      (∀ s : List Bool, M.tm.runFrom (splitBank M s (some start) []) (B s.length) =
        splitBank M s none (List.replicate (C * (s.length + 1) ^ e) true)) ∧
      (∀ l, B l ≤ (C + 1 + 5 * e) * (l + 1) ^ e + 1) := by
  cases e with
  | zero =>
    exact ⟨prependTM (List.replicate C true), (0 : Fin ((List.replicate C true).length + 1)),
      fun _ => C + 1, rfl, fun s => by simpa using splitSource_constant C s, fun l => by simp⟩
  | succ e =>
    exact ⟨catalogPolyUnaryTM e C, .loop (Fin.last e),
      fun l => catalogPolyCost (l + 1) C (e + 1) + 1, rfl, splitSource_poly e C,
      fun l => Nat.add_le_add_right (catalogPolyCost_le (l + 1) C (by omega) (e + 1)) 1⟩

/-- The length counter at the split search's round budget. -/
private theorem MIG1Probe.split_fuel (C e : ℕ) :
    lengthBitsTM.ComputesFunInTime (fun w => Nat.bits (id w.length))
      (fun n => ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)) := by
  intro w
  refine (lengthBitsTM_computes w).mono ?_
  have hn : w.length + 1 ≤ (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) := Nat.le_self_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero e) _
  exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 5 hn).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _))

/-- Probe of `splitSolveTM_computes`. -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_splitSolveTM_computes : type_of% @splitSolveTM_computes := by
  intro C e
  obtain ⟨M, start, B, heq, hsource, hbound⟩ := MIG1Probe.split_sources C e
  obtain ⟨hstart, hround⟩ := MIG1Probe.split_hyps C e M start B hsource hbound
  rw [heq]
  have hM := loopHostTM_finds (splitBodyTM M start) lengthBitsTM .anchor
    (fun w s => s.length ≤ w.length + 1) splitStep (splitAccept C e)
    (fun w s => pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)) (fun _ => [])
    id (fun n => ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1))
    (MIG1Probe.split_fuel C e) (by intro w; simp) splitStep_inv hstart hround
  intro w
  have hm := hM w
  dsimp only [id_eq] at hm
  have hb : 10 * (((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) + 1) *
      (w.length + 2) ≤ 20 * ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 46) * (w.length + 1) ^ (e + 2) :=
    (splitLoop_bound 10 ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) e w.length).trans
      (le_of_eq (by ring))
  convert hm.mono hb using 1
  exact (splitLoop_result C e w).symm

/-- Probe of `loopHostTM_spaceUsed_le_budget`: the space half of `f2_exists_loopFind_space`,
which uses nothing about the mode. -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_loopHostTM_spaceUsed_le_budget :
    type_of% @loopHostTM_spaceUsed_le_budget := by
  intro body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF out findMode s0 R T hF hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround x t
  let E := loopHostTM body F anchor findMode
  obtain ⟨cfg, startup, hs, hinit, _, hend, _, hsegments, hheads, hterminal⟩ :=
    loopHost_contracts_heads body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF out findMode s0 R T hF hInv0
      hInvStep hstart hround x
  have h := f2_seamed_space E x cfg (R x.length + 1) (10 * (T x.length + 1))
    (T x.length) startup hs hinit (fun j hj => hheads j (by omega)) hend hterminal
    (by
      intro j hj
      obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := hsegments j (by omega)
      refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
      split at he
      · exact Or.inl he.1
      · exact Or.inr he) t
  have hb : 2 * (T x.length + 10 * (T x.length + 1)) + 1 ≤ 23 * (T x.length + 1) := by omega
  calc
    _ ≤ E.k * (23 * (T x.length + 1)) := h.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hb)
    _ = 23 * E.k * (T x.length + 1) := by ring

/-- Probe of `splitSolveTM_spaceUsed`, from the budget theorem. -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_splitSolveTM_spaceUsed : type_of% @splitSolveTM_spaceUsed := by
  intro C e x t
  obtain ⟨M, start, B, heq, hsource, hbound⟩ := MIG1Probe.split_sources C e
  obtain ⟨hstart, hround⟩ := MIG1Probe.split_hyps C e M start B hsource hbound
  rw [heq]
  refine (loopHostTM_spaceUsed_le_budget (splitBodyTM M start) lengthBitsTM .anchor
    (fun w s => s.length ≤ w.length + 1) splitStep (splitAccept C e)
    (fun w s => pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)) true (fun _ => [])
    id (fun n => ((C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e + 40 + 5) * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1))
    (MIG1Probe.split_fuel C e) (by intro w; simp) splitStep_inv hstart hround x t).trans ?_
  have hp : 1 ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (Nat.succ_pos _)
  generalize (x.length + 1) ^ (e + 1) = P at hp ⊢
  generalize (C + 1 + 5 * e) * 2 ^ e = A
  calc 23 * (loopHostTM (splitBodyTM M start) lengthBitsTM .anchor true).k *
        ((A + 40 + 5) * P + 1)
      ≤ 23 * (loopHostTM (splitBodyTM M start) lengthBitsTM .anchor true).k *
        ((A + 46) * P) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by
          have : (A + 46) * P = (A + 40 + 5) * P + P := by ring
          omega)
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Probe of `splitSolveWithTM_computes` (today's `emitterP2_closed` and
`emitterSplit_of_body`, with every existential named). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_splitSolveWithTM_computes : type_of% @splitSolveWithTM_computes := by
  intro f E TE hTE hE
  let C := callTM E false
  let D := callTM lengthBitsTM false
  let B := emitterP2BodyTM C D (callTM_k_pos E false) (callTM_k_pos lengthBitsTM false)
    (callEntry E false) (callExit E false) (callEntry lengthBitsTM false)
    (callExit lengthBitsTM false)
  let A := 2 * (24 + 13 * E.k) + (24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) * (2 * 5 + 1) + 10 * (5 + 8)
  -- the install-call contracts of the two named calls, from `callTM_run`
  have hCall (M : FinTM Bool) (g : List Bool → List Bool) (Tg : ℕ → ℕ)
      (hg : M.ComputesFunInTime g Tg) (x arg : List Bool) :
      ∃ t ≤ (24 + 13 * M.k) * (Tg arg.length + arg.length + (g arg).length + 1), 0 < t ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t → ((callTM M false).tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M false) (stateWord (callTM M false).k arg))
            t').state ≠ some (callExit M false)) ∧
        (callTM M false).tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M false) (stateWord (callTM M false).k arg)) t =
            Cfg.ofWords (callExit M false) (stateWord (callTM M false).k (g arg)) := by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hpos, hfirst, hr⟩ := callTM_run M false x arg (g arg) (Tg arg.length) (hg arg)
    exact ⟨t, ht, hpos, fun j _ hj => hfirst j hj, by simpa using hr⟩
  have hstart : ∀ w : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ (A + 5) * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2),
      (∀ t' < t, (B.tm.runFrom (B.tm.initCfg w) t').state ≠ some .anchor) ∧
      B.tm.runFrom (B.tm.initCfg w) t = Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord B.k []) := fun w =>
    ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, fun j hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero _),
      emitterP2_body_start C D _ _ _ _ _ _ w⟩
  have hround : ∀ (w s : List Bool), s.length ≤ w.length + 1 →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ (A + 5) * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2) ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord B.k s)) t').state
            ≠ some .anchor) ∧
        if emitterSplitAccept f w s then
          (B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord B.k s)) t).state = none ∧
          (B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord B.k s)) t).output =
            pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)
        else
          B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := w) .anchor (stateWord B.k s)) t =
            Cfg.ofWords .anchor (stateWord B.k (splitStep w s)) := by
    intro w s hs
    have hL := lengthBitsTM_computes
    let H := TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2
    let u := Nat.bits (f s.length)
    let v := Nat.bits (w.drop s.length).length
    obtain ⟨_, hu, hmono⟩ := emitter_width_budget f E TE hTE hE w s hs
    have hdrop : (w.drop s.length).length ≤ w.length := by
      simp only [List.length_drop]; omega
    have hv : v.length ≤ 5 * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1) := by
      have hout := ((computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp (hL (w.drop s.length))).2
      simpa only [hout, v] using lengthBitsTM.tm.output_length_le (w.drop s.length)
        (5 * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1))
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hap, haf, har⟩ := hCall E (fun s => Nat.bits (f s.length)) TE hE w s
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbp, hbf, hbr⟩ :=
      hCall lengthBitsTM (fun s => Nat.bits s.length) (fun n => 5 * (n + 1)) hL w
        (w.drop s.length)
    obtain ⟨t, htpos, ht, hfirst, hr⟩ := emitterP2_body_round f C D _ _ _ _ _ _
      w s a b hap hbp haf har hbf hbr
    refine ⟨t, htpos, ?_, hfirst, hr⟩
    have hHs : s.length ≤ H := by dsimp [H]; omega
    have hHn : w.length ≤ H := by dsimp [H]; omega
    have hHu : u.length ≤ H := by dsimp [u, H]; omega
    have hLd : 5 * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1) ≤ 5 * H :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left 5 (by dsimp [H]; omega)
    have hHv : v.length ≤ 5 * H := hv.trans hLd
    have hCa : TE s.length + s.length + u.length + 1 ≤ 2 * H := by
      dsimp [u, H]; omega
    have hCa' : a ≤ (2 * (24 + 13 * E.k)) * H := by
      calc
        a ≤ (24 + 13 * E.k) * (TE s.length + s.length + u.length + 1) := ha
        _ ≤ (24 + 13 * E.k) * (2 * H) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hCa
        _ = (2 * (24 + 13 * E.k)) * H := by ring
    have hDb : 5 * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1) + (w.drop s.length).length + v.length + 1 ≤
        (2 * 5 + 1) * H := by
      dsimp [H] at *; omega
    have hDb' : b ≤ ((24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) * (2 * 5 + 1)) * H := by
      calc
        b ≤ (24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) *
            (5 * ((w.drop s.length).length + 1) + (w.drop s.length).length + v.length + 1) :=
          hb
        _ ≤ (24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) * ((2 * 5 + 1) * H) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hDb
        _ = ((24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) * (2 * 5 + 1)) * H := by ring
    have hsum : s.length + w.length + u.length + v.length + 10 ≤ (5 + 8) * H := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul]
      omega
    calc
      t ≤ a + b + 10 * (s.length + w.length + u.length + v.length + 10) := ht
      _ ≤ (2 * (24 + 13 * E.k)) * H + ((24 + 13 * lengthBitsTM.k) * (2 * 5 + 1)) * H +
          10 * ((5 + 8) * H) :=
        Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add hCa' hDb') (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hsum)
      _ = A * H := by dsimp [A]; ring
      _ ≤ (A + 5) * H := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  have hF : lengthBitsTM.ComputesFunInTime (fun w => Nat.bits (id w.length))
      (fun n => (A + 5) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2)) := by
    intro w
    refine (lengthBitsTM_computes w).mono ?_
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 5 (by omega : w.length + 1 ≤
      TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2)).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega))
  have hM := loopHostTM_finds B lengthBitsTM .anchor
    (fun w s => s.length ≤ w.length + 1) splitStep (emitterSplitAccept f)
    (fun w s => pairEncode (w.take s.length) (w.drop s.length)) (fun _ => [])
    id (fun n => (A + 5) * (TE (n + 1) + n + 2)) hF (by intro w; simp) splitStep_inv
    hstart hround
  intro w
  have hm := hM w
  dsimp only [id_eq] at hm
  have hb : 10 * ((A + 5) * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2) + 1) * (w.length + 2) ≤
      20 * (591 + 26 * E.k) * (w.length + 1) * (TE (w.length + 1) + w.length + 2) :=
    (emitterSplit_loop_bound 10 (A + 5) w.length (TE (w.length + 1))).trans
      (le_of_eq (by simp only [A, show lengthBitsTM.k = 1 from rfl]; ring))
  convert hm.mono hb using 1
  exact (emitterSplit_result f w).symm

end Turing.FinTM

/-- Statement shim of `idTM_run` (`Composition.lean:100`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma idTM_run (x : List Bool) : ∀ t, t ≤ x.length →
    (idTM.tm.runFrom (idTM.tm.initCfg x) t).state = some () ∧
    (((idTM.tm.runFrom (idTM.tm.initCfg x) t).inputPos : ℕ) = t + 1) ∧
    (idTM.tm.runFrom (idTM.tm.initCfg x) t).output = x.take t := by
  sorry

/-- Statement shim of `ifEq_run` (`Composition.lean:226`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma ifEq_run (w₀ u v x : List Bool) :
    ∀ (r i : ℕ) (hlen : w₀.length = i + r), i ≤ x.length → x.take i = w₀.take i →
    ∀ (cfg : Cfg 0 Bool (ifEqTM w₀ u v).State x),
      cfg.state = some (.inl ⟨i, by omega⟩) → cfg.inputPos.val = i + 1 → cfg.output = [] →
      ∃ t, t ≤ r + max u.length v.length + 2 ∧
        ((ifEqTM w₀ u v).tm.runFrom cfg t).state = none ∧
        ((ifEqTM w₀ u v).tm.runFrom cfg t).output = if x = w₀ then u else v := by
  sorry

      (condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) t =
        rightCfg (fun q => .inr (.inr q)) ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) tapes heads := by
  sorry
private def redirectState {S : Type} (haltOn : Bool) (q : Option S)
    (r : Option Bool) : Option ((S × Option Bool) ⊕ Unit) :=
  match q with
  | some s => some (.inl (s, r))
  | none => if r = some haltOn then none else some (.inr ())

private def redirectCfg (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) : Cfg (redirectTM M haltOn).k Bool
      (redirectTM M haltOn).State x :=
  ⟨redirectState haltOn c.state c.output.getLast?, c.inputPos,
    c.workTapes, c.workTapePos, []⟩
/-- Statement shim of `redirect_run` (`Wrappers.lean:411`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma redirect_run (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t =
      redirectCfg M haltOn (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t) := by
  sorry
private def scanCfg {S : Type} (x : List Bool) (q : Option S)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) : Cfg 0 Bool S x :=
  ⟨q, ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩, fun j => j.elim0, fun j => j.elim0, out⟩

    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) :
    (scanCfg x q i hi out).inputSymbol = x[i]? := by
  sorry

**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma emitterToken_run (x rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre out (hx : x = pre ++ rest),

/-- Statement shim of `loop_halted_run` (`Loop.lean:2296`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma loop_halted_run {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x)
    (accept : ℕ → Bool) (B N : ℕ)
    (hend : (cfg N).state = none ∧ (cfg N).output = [false])
    (hround : ∀ j < N, ∃ t ≤ B,
      if accept j then
        (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).state = none ∧
          (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).output = [true]
      else tm.runFrom (cfg j) t = cfg (j + 1)) :
    ∃ t ≤ N * B, (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).output = [(List.range N).any accept] := by
  sorry

/-- Statement shim of `loop_find_run` (`Loop.lean:2435`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma loop_find_run {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x)
    (accept : ℕ → Bool) (payload : ℕ → List Bool) (B N : ℕ)
    (hend : (cfg N).state = none ∧ (cfg N).output = [])
    (hround : ∀ j < N, ∃ t ≤ B,
      if accept j then
        (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).state = none ∧
          (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).output = payload j
      else tm.runFrom (cfg j) t = cfg (j + 1)) :
    ∃ t ≤ N * B, (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).output =
        (match (List.range N).find? accept with | some i => payload i | none => []) := by
  sorry
/-- Statement shim of `emCall_first` (`Loop.lean:4592`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma emCall_first (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesInTime arg cap T) :
    ∃ t ≤ (24 + 13 * M.k) * (T + arg.length + cap.length + 1),
      0 < t ∧
      (∀ j < t, ((callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callTM M emit).tm.q₀ (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) j).state
          ≠ some (.inr (.inr (5 : Fin 6)))) ∧
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callTM M emit).tm.q₀ (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) t =
        { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (.inr (.inr (5 : Fin 6)) : emCallState M)
            (stateWord (callTM M emit).k (if emit then arg else cap))
          with output := if emit then cap else [] } := by
  sorry
private def fwdMapVirtual (M : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State y) (tag : Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (a pre : List Bool) : Cfg (1 + (1 + M.k)) Bool (FwdMapState M.State) x where
  state := c.state.map (fun q => .run q tag)
  inputPos := p
  workTapes := tapeBlocks (fun _ => bufferTape a) (bufferTape y) c.workTapes
  workTapePos := tapeBlocks (fun _ => (a.length : ℤ)) ((c.inputPos.val : ℤ) - 1) c.workTapePos
  output := pre ++ c.output

**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/

    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State y) (tag : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos tag)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (a pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ tag', VirtualTag (M.tm.runFrom c t).inputPos tag' ∧
      (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom (fwdMapVirtual M c tag p a pre) t =
        fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.runFrom c t) tag' p a pre := by
  sorry

      (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) = 0 := by

/-- Statement shim of `fwdMap_launch` (`Catalog.lean:5740`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/

    (hd : pairDecode x = some (a, b)) :

      (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u =
        fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.initCfg b) true ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ a (pairEncode a []) ∧
      ∀ v ≤ u, (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) v =
        (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) v := by

**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/

        (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) v := by

/-- Statement shim of `fwdMap_space` (`Catalog.lean:5841`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma fwdMap_space (M : FinTM Bool) (x y : List Bool) (t D S : ℕ)
    (hfirst : ∀ u ≤ t, -(D : ℤ) ≤
        ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos
          (Fin.castAdd (1 + M.k) (0 : Fin 1)) ∧
      ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos

    (hsecond : ∀ u ≤ t, -(D : ℤ) ≤

      ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos

    (hsource : ∀ i, (fwdMapTM M true).tm.visitedByTapeHead ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) t
        (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) ⊆ M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg y) t i)
    (hs : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg y) t ≤ S) :

/-- Probe of `idTM_computes` (the body of `computesFunInTime_id`). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_idTM_computes : type_of% @idTM_computes := by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨hstate, hpos, hout⟩ := idTM_run x x.length (le_refl _)
  have h0 : (idTM.tm.runFrom (idTM.tm.initCfg x) x.length).inputPos ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hpos
    simp at hpos
  have hsym : (idTM.tm.runFrom (idTM.tm.initCfg x) x.length).inputSymbol = none := by
    unfold Cfg.inputSymbol
    rw [dif_neg h0, dif_pos (by omega)]
  have hrun1 : idTM.tm.runFrom (idTM.tm.initCfg x) (x.length + 1) =
      (idTM.tm.tr () none
        ((idTM.tm.runFrom (idTM.tm.initCfg x) x.length).workTapeSymbols)).apply
        (idTM.tm.runFrom (idTM.tm.initCfg x) x.length) := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
    unfold MultiTapeTM.step
    rw [hstate]
    dsimp only
    rw [hsym]
  refine ⟨_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
  · rw [hrun1]
    simp [idTM, Action.apply]
  · rw [hrun1]
    simp only [idTM, Action.apply]
    rw [hout]
    simp

    ((ifEqTM w₀ u v).tm.initCfg x) rfl (by simp) rfl
  have hbase : (ifEqTM w₀ u v).ComputesInTime x (if x = w₀ then u else v) t :=
    ⟨_, hs, ho, rfl⟩
  exact hbase.mono (Nat.le_trans (by omega) (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)))

/-- Probe of `condTM_computes_iff` (the body of `exists_cond`). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_condTM_computes_iff : type_of% @condTM_computes_iff := by
  intro D M₁ M₂ p hD x w
  obtain ⟨a, tapes, heads, ha⟩ := condTM_start D M₁ M₂ x (p x) (hD x)
  have hr (t : ℕ) :
      (condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((condTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) (a + t) =
        rightCfg (fun q => .inr (.inr q))
          ((branchTM M₁ M₂ (p x)).tm.runFrom ((branchTM M₁ M₂ (p x)).tm.initCfg x) t)
          tapes heads := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, ha]
    exact rightCfg_run (branchTM M₁ M₂ (p x)).tm (condTM D M₁ M₂).tm
      (fun q => .inr (.inr q)) (fun _ _ _ => rfl) _ tapes heads t
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    have hc := (computesInTime_iff (condTM D M₁ M₂) x w (a + t)).mp
      (ht.mono (by omega))
    rw [hr t] at hc
    have hb : (branchTM M₁ M₂ (p x)).ComputesInTime x w t :=
      (computesInTime_iff _ x w t).mpr
        ⟨by simpa only [rightCfg, Option.map_eq_none_iff] using hc.1, hc.2⟩
    exact ⟨t, (branchTM_computes M₁ M₂ (p x) x w t).mp hb⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    have hb := (computesInTime_iff (branchTM M₁ M₂ (p x)) x w t).mp
      ((branchTM_computes M₁ M₂ (p x) x w t).mpr ht)
    refine ⟨a + t, (computesInTime_iff _ x w (a + t)).mpr ?_⟩
    rw [hr t]
    exact ⟨by simpa only [rightCfg, Option.map_eq_none_iff] using hb.1, hb.2⟩

/-- Probe of `unaryTokenTM_computes` (the body of `computesFunInTime_unaryToken`). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_unaryTokenTM_computes : type_of% @unaryTokenTM_computes := by
  intro x
  have hr := emitterToken_run x x [] [] rfl
  have hc : unaryTokenTM.ComputesInTime x
      (pairEncode (unaryTokenSplit x).1 (unaryTokenSplit x).2)
      (2 * (unaryTokenSplit x).1.length + (unaryTokenSplit x).2.length + 3) := by
    apply (FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr
    have hinit : unaryTokenTM.tm.initCfg x =

/-- Probe of `appendBitTM_computes` (the body of `computesFunInTime_appendBit`). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_appendBitTM_computes : type_of% @appendBitTM_computes := by
  intro b x
  apply (FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr

  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  change let d := ((appendBitTM b).tm.tr ()
    (scanCfg x (some ()) x.length (by omega) (x.take x.length)).inputSymbol _).apply _

/-- Probe of `loopHostTM_decides` (the body of `exists_loopTM`, from the gated contract). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_loopHostTM_decides : type_of% @loopHostTM_decides := by
  intro body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF s0 R T hF hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround x
  have hc := loopHostTM_contracts body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF (fun _ _ => [true]) false
    s0 R T hF hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround
  let E := loopHostTM body F anchor false
  obtain ⟨cfg, startup, hs, hinit, _, hend, hout, hsegments⟩ := hc x
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hhalt, houtput⟩ := loop_halted_run E.tm cfg
    (fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))) (10 * (T x.length + 1))
    (R x.length + 1) ⟨hend, by simpa using hout⟩
    (fun j hj => by simpa using hsegments j (by omega))
  have hrun := E.tm.runFrom_add (E.tm.initCfg x) startup t
  rw [hinit] at hrun
  have hcompute : E.ComputesInTime x
      [(List.range (R x.length + 1)).any
        (fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)))] (startup + t) := by
    refine ⟨_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
    · rw [hrun]; exact hhalt
    · rw [hrun]; exact houtput
  apply hcompute.mono
  calc startup + t ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1) +
        (R x.length + 1) * (10 * (T x.length + 1)) := Nat.add_le_add hs ht
    _ = 10 * (T x.length + 1) * (R x.length + 2) := by ring

/-- Probe of `loopHostTM_finds` (the body of `exists_loopFindTM`, from the gated contract). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_loopHostTM_finds : type_of% @loopHostTM_finds := by
  intro body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF out s0 R T hF hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround x
  have hc := loopHostTM_contracts body F anchor Inv stepF acceptF out true s0 R T
    hF hInv0 hInvStep hstart hround
  let E := loopHostTM body F anchor true
  obtain ⟨cfg, startup, hs, hinit, _, hend, hout, hsegments⟩ := hc x
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hhalt, houtput⟩ := loop_find_run E.tm cfg
    (fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)))
    (fun i => out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))) (10 * (T x.length + 1)) (R x.length + 1)
    ⟨hend, by simpa using hout⟩
    (fun j hj => by simpa using hsegments j (by omega))
  have hrun := E.tm.runFrom_add (E.tm.initCfg x) startup t
  rw [hinit] at hrun
  have hcompute : E.ComputesInTime x
      (match (List.range (R x.length + 1)).find?
          (fun i => acceptF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))) with
        | some i => out x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))
        | none => []) (startup + t) := by
    refine ⟨_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
    · rw [hrun]; exact hhalt
    · rw [hrun]; exact houtput
  apply hcompute.mono
  calc startup + t ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1) +
        (R x.length + 1) * (10 * (T x.length + 1)) := Nat.add_le_add hs ht
    _ = 10 * (T x.length + 1) * (R x.length + 2) := by ring

/-- Probe of `polyUnaryTM_spaceUsed` (no work tapes at `e = 0`; Catalog's `f2_poly_space`,
renamed to the engine, at `e = d + 1`). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_polyUnaryTM_spaceUsed : type_of% @polyUnaryTM_spaceUsed := by
  intro C e x t
  cases e with
  | zero =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_zero_tapes_eq_zero _ _ rfl]
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  | succ d => exact catalogPoly_space d C x t

/-- Probe of `pairMapSndTM_computes` (the time half of `computesFunInTime_pairMapSnd_spaceUsed`,
over the moved forwarding family). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_pairMapSndTM_computes : type_of% @pairMapSndTM_computes := by
  intro Mg g Tg hg hTg x
  unfold pairMapSndTM
  let M := fwdMapTM Mg true
  cases hd : pairDecode x with
  | none =>
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hh, ho, _⟩ := fwdMap_reject Mg x hd
    have ht : M.ComputesInTime x [] u := ⟨_, hh, ho, rfl⟩
    simpa only [hd] using ht.mono (show u ≤ 22 * (x.length + 1 + Tg x.length) by omega)
  | some ab =>
    rcases ab with ⟨a, b⟩
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hinit, _⟩ := fwdMap_launch Mg x a b hd
    have hlen : b.length ≤ x.length := by
      have h := congrArg List.length (eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode x a b hd)
      rw [length_pairEncode] at h
      omega
    obtain ⟨tag, _, hr⟩ := fwdMapVirtual_run Mg (x := x) (Mg.tm.initCfg b) true
      (by simp [VirtualTag, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init])
      (⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩) a (pairEncode a []) (Tg b.length)
    obtain ⟨space, hh, ho, _⟩ := hg b
    have hrun : M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) (u + Tg b.length) =
        fwdMapVirtual Mg (Mg.tm.runFrom (Mg.tm.initCfg b) (Tg b.length)) tag
          ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ a (pairEncode a []) := by
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hinit]
      exact hr
    have ht : M.ComputesInTime x (pairEncode a (g b)) (u + Tg b.length) := by
      refine ⟨_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
      · rw [hrun]
        change Option.map (fun q => FwdMapState.run q tag)
          (Mg.tm.runFrom (Mg.tm.initCfg b) (Tg b.length)).state = none
        rw [hh]
        rfl
      · rw [hrun]
        change pairEncode a [] ++
          (Mg.tm.runFrom (Mg.tm.initCfg b) (Tg b.length)).output = pairEncode a (g b)
        rw [ho]
        simp [pairEncode, List.append_assoc]
    have hT := hTg hlen
    simpa only [hd] using ht.mono
      (show u + Tg b.length ≤ 22 * (x.length + 1 + Tg x.length) by omega)

/-- Probe of `pairMapSndTM_spaceUsed` (the space half of the same row; the head bound now comes
from the gated `abs_workTapePos_runFrom_sub_le` instead of the copied `f2_head_steps`). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_pairMapSndTM_spaceUsed : type_of% @pairMapSndTM_spaceUsed := by
  intro Mg Sg hgs hSg x t
  unfold pairMapSndTM
  let M := fwdMapTM Mg true
  let D := 5 * (x.length + 1)
  have hshort (v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ D) (i : Fin M.k) :
      -(D : ℤ) ≤ (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos i ∧
      (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos i ≤ D := by
    have h := abs_le.mp (MultiTapeTM.abs_workTapePos_runFrom_sub_le M.tm (M.tm.initCfg x) v i)
    rw [show (M.tm.initCfg x).workTapePos i = 0 from rfl, sub_zero] at h
    constructor <;> omega
  cases hd : pairDecode x with
  | none =>
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hh, _, heq⟩ := fwdMap_reject Mg x hd
    have hheads (v : ℕ) (i : Fin M.k) :
        -(D : ℤ) ≤ (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos i ∧
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos i ≤ D := by
      by_cases hv : v ≤ u
      · exact hshort v (hv.trans hu) i
      · rw [show v = u + (v - u) by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add,
          MultiTapeTM.runFrom_of_halt _ hh]
        exact hshort u hu i
    have hp (i : Fin Mg.k) : M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg x) t
        (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) ⊆ Mg.tm.visitedByTapeHead (Mg.tm.initCfg x) t i := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
      change ((fwdMapTM Mg true).tm.runFrom _ v).workTapePos _ ∈ _
      rw [heq v, fwdMapSetup_heads]
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨0, by simp, rfl⟩
    have hs := fwdMap_space Mg x x t D (Sg x.length)
      (fun v _ => hheads v _) (fun v _ => hheads v _) hp (hgs x t)
    change M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ _ at hs
    dsimp only [D] at hs
    omega
  | some ab =>
    rcases ab with ⟨a, b⟩
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hinit, hprefix⟩ := fwdMap_launch Mg x a b hd
    have hlen : a.length ≤ x.length ∧ b.length ≤ x.length := by
      have h := congrArg List.length (eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode x a b hd)
      rw [length_pairEncode] at h
      omega
    have hrun (v : ℕ) : ∃ tag,
        M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) (u + v) =
          fwdMapVirtual Mg (Mg.tm.runFrom (Mg.tm.initCfg b) v) tag
            ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ a (pairEncode a []) := by
      obtain ⟨tag, _, he⟩ := fwdMapVirtual_run Mg (x := x) (Mg.tm.initCfg b) true
        (by simp [VirtualTag, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init])
        (⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩) a (pairEncode a []) v
      refine ⟨tag, ?_⟩
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hinit]
      exact he
    have ha (v : ℕ) : -(D : ℤ) ≤
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos (Fin.castAdd (1 + Mg.k) (0 : Fin 1)) ∧
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos
          (Fin.castAdd (1 + Mg.k) (0 : Fin 1)) ≤ D := by
      by_cases hv : v ≤ u
      · exact hshort v (hv.trans hu) _
      · obtain ⟨tag, he⟩ := hrun (v - u)
        rw [show v = u + (v - u) by omega, he]
        simp only [fwdMapVirtual, tapeBlocks_left]
        dsimp only [D]
        constructor <;> omega
    have hb (v : ℕ) : -(D : ℤ) ≤
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos
          (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd Mg.k (0 : Fin 1))) ∧
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos
          (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd Mg.k (0 : Fin 1))) ≤ D := by
      by_cases hv : v ≤ u
      · exact hshort v (hv.trans hu) _
      · obtain ⟨tag, he⟩ := hrun (v - u)
        rw [show v = u + (v - u) by omega, he]
        simp only [fwdMapVirtual, tapeBlocks_buffer]
        have hp := (Mg.tm.runFrom (Mg.tm.initCfg b) (v - u)).inputPos.isLt
        dsimp only [D]
        constructor <;> omega
    have hp (i : Fin Mg.k) : M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg x) t
        (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) ⊆ Mg.tm.visitedByTapeHead (Mg.tm.initCfg b) t i := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
      have hvt : v ≤ t := by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hv; omega
      by_cases hvu : v ≤ u
      · change ((fwdMapTM Mg true).tm.runFrom _ v).workTapePos _ ∈ _
        rw [hprefix v hvu, fwdMapSetup_heads]
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨0, by simp, rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨tag, he⟩ := hrun (v - u)
        change (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos _ ∈ _
        rw [show v = u + (v - u) by omega, he]
        simp only [fwdMapVirtual, tapeBlocks_right]
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v - u, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), rfl⟩
    have hs := fwdMap_space Mg x b t D (Sg x.length)
      (fun v _ => ha v) (fun v _ => hb v) hp ((hgs b t).trans (hSg hlen.2))
    change M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ _ at hs
    dsimp only [D] at hs
    omega

end Turing.FinTM

namespace Turing

-- @shim begin (verbatim from `TuringMachine/Encoding.lean`)
private def pairDiagCfg (x : List Bool) (q : Option (Fin 6))
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (out : List Bool) : Cfg 0 Bool (Fin 6) x :=
  ⟨q, p, fun i => i.elim0, fun i => i.elim0, out⟩
/-- Statement shim of `pairDiag_run` (`Encoding.lean:455`), proved in the tree.
**Proof sketch.** See the source. -/
private lemma pairDiag_run (x : List Bool) :
    pairDiagTM.tm.runFrom (pairDiagTM.tm.initCfg x) (4 * x.length + 5) =
      pairDiagCfg x none ⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ (pairEncode x x) := by
  sorry
-- @shim end

/-- Probe of `pairDiagTM_computes` (the `have h` of `computesFunInTime_pairEncode_diag`). -/
theorem MIG1Probe.spec_pairDiagTM_computes : type_of% @pairDiagTM_computes := by
  intro x
  refine ⟨_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
  · rw [pairDiag_run]; rfl
  · rw [pairDiag_run]; rfl

end Turing

import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Catalog
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# MIG-1 bridge and duplicate probe (not landed)

1. **The loop-host bridge** (design §11, risk 1). Catalog's 21 modified loop-host copies are
   stated for `f2_loopHost`, copied from an older `Build/Loop.lean` before the forwarding flag.
   With verbatim copies of both definition families, `rfl` shows that the old host is the
   current shared controller at `forward = false`, so the moved budget proofs can be re-targeted
   at `loopHostM _ _ _ false` (today's `loopHost`, the gate's `loopHostTM`) by rewriting alone.
2. **Duplicates of existing public declarations.** Four private Catalog lemmas of the region
   have the statements of `Fin.sum_univ_add` (Mathlib), `Turing.MultiTapeTM.timed_input_bound`
   and `Turing.eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode`; each `example` proves the copied statement
   (verbatim) by the public declaration in one term.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§1.2: the machine model.)
-/

namespace Turing.FinTM

-- @shim begin (verbatim from `Build/Catalog.lean`: the old loop host)
-- @@verbatim Catalog - --nodoc f2_loopBodyTM f2_LoopHostState f2_loopFuelSource f2_loopBodySource f2_loopControlAction f2_loopHost
-- @shim end

-- @shim begin (verbatim from `Build/Loop.lean`: the current shared controller)
-- @@verbatim Loop - --nodoc loopBodyTM LoopHostState loopFuelSource loopBodySource loopControlAction loopBodyDispatch loopHostM
-- @shim end

/-- The old host is the shared controller with the forwarding flag off, definitionally. -/
example (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (findMode : Bool) :
    f2_loopHost body F anchor findMode = loopHostM body F anchor false findMode := rfl

/-- `f2_sum_add` (`Build/Catalog.lean:10468`) is `Fin.sum_univ_add`. -/
example {a b : ℕ} (f : Fin (a + b) → ℕ) :
    (∑ i : Fin (a + b), f i) =
      (∑ i : Fin a, f (Fin.castAdd b i)) + ∑ i : Fin b, f (Fin.natAdd a i) :=
  Fin.sum_univ_add f

/-- `f2_loop_input_run_le` (`Build/Catalog.lean:6126`) is `MultiTapeTM.timed_input_bound`. -/
example {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ) :
    (tm.runFrom c t).inputPos.val ≤ c.inputPos.val + t :=
  tm.timed_input_bound c t

/-- `f2_catalogPair_inverse` (`Build/Catalog.lean:4166`) is `Turing.eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode`
with its binders reordered. -/
example (x : List Bool) :
    ∀ a v, pairDecode x = some (a, v) → x = pairEncode a v :=
  fun a v h => Turing.eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode x a v h

end Turing.FinTM
